clean_body: | | | IN CASE YOU MISSED IT New Trump SBA leader launches manufacturing deregulation initiative in Indianapolis | | The Indianapolis Star Brittany Carloni March 10, 2025 President Donald Trump's newly-confirmed U.S. Small Business Administration head visited Indianapolis on Monday to launch a manufacturing initiative seeking to cut $100 billion in regulations for small business manufacturers. But while SBA Administrator Kelly Loeffler's goal was to tout the administration's “Made in America Manufacturing Initiative,” her Indy visit came amid uncertainty over the impact of retaliatory tariffs on businesses, and one week after Trump called for an end to the CHIPS and Science Act. That law, which boosted domestic manufacturing of computer chips and contained money for some small business initiatives, was championed by Sen. Todd Young. He joined Loeffler on her tour of Aerodyn Engineering, alongside Gov. Mike Braun and U.S. Sen. Jim Banks on Monday. The tour was one of Loeffler's first stops since officially joining the Trump administration last month, and one of the first times Braun and Young and Banks had to share the limelight since Banks and Braun took office in January. Loeffler said Indiana was among her first visits since her confirmation because of the state’s role in the manufacturing industry. Indiana in 2023 had the highest concentration of manufacturing jobs than anywhere else in the country, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. The SBA manufacturing initiative’s focus on deregulation will help Indiana continue to be a “business-friendly” state, Loeffler said. "It’s critically important that Washington understands that it’s free enterprise that creates economic opportunity, not the government,” Loeffler said. “By working together, at the state and federal levels, we can make sure that we don’t stifle innovation, but we help feed innovation.” In addition to cutting billions of regulations, the SBA’s “Made in America Manufacturing Initiative” will include: Creating a “red tape” hotline for small businesses to share “onerous” regulations to be reviewed Reducing barriers to a loan program to provide financial support for purchasing real estate, equipment and construction Expanding a financing program for inventory purchases and expenses tied to exporting products to international markets Partnering with trade schools and businesses to boost the manufacturing workforce Supporting Trump priorities, including tariffs and tax cuts on production in the U.S. Loeffler, a former U.S. senator from Georgia, previously served in Congress with Braun, Young and Banks. The four talked as they walked through the manufacturing facility together and listened to Aerodyn founder and owner Dave Lawrence share about the parts the company makes. Braun said Loeffler, “a farm girl from Illinois” knows what kind of environment is needed for small businesses to be successful and, as a former small business owner himself, looks forward to working with Loeffler in his new role as governor. “I'm the steward of Indiana being considered one of the top places in the country to start a business, grow a business, raise a family,” Braun said. “So we are blessed to have someone in the SBA that is going to be that interface with Main Street.” Loeffler talks tariffs, CHIPS Act** Loeffler took questions from reporters and business leaders on Monday, including on the impacts tariffs might have on small businesses and whether the CHIPS Act fits into the SBA manufacturing initiative. Trump last week postponed tariffs on products from Canada and Mexico after announcing plans to implement them on the two countries. Loeffler said while there may be an adjustment period for small businesses under Trump's trade policies, the president is "defending the American worker" and strengthening American supply chains. "Creating an economy where we have strong, blue collar, good-paying jobs and an economy that lifts everyone up, I think it'll be almost imperceptible relative to the gains that lay ahead," she said. On the CHIPS Act, Loeffler emphasized that Trump has initiated major capital investments in his first weeks in office. "The best dollar can come from the private sector, from that investment, and that way taxpayers can make sure that they're not being asked to build these," she said. "I think it's really important that we work on a public-private partnership basis to instill that accountability within government." Young's office last week said they planned to seek clarity on Trump's comments on the CHIPS Act during his address to Congress. A spokesperson on Monday told IndyStar that Young is "open to working with the administration on changes to the law." | | | | | | PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE. | | NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. Hi friends,

I don't know about you, but I'm pretty eager for new voices and new leadership within the Democratic Party - and beyond.

If you sound like every other politician who got us here, I don't want to hear it.

This isn't ideological for me; passion and authenticity resonate with me whether it's from a democratic socialist like AOC or a CEO like Mark Cuban.

One of those new voices that has impressed me when he has visited us here in NH is Congressman Ro Khanna. Anyone who both co-chaired Bernie's campaign and represents Silicon Valley turns my head. Colin

I wish I didn't have to write this piece, but most media has moved on while the injustices continue. Despite a January 19 ceasefire, Netanyahu has [continued to bomb northern Gaza, and now has cut off all aid into Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/63d61793-12f1-4dd8-81be-ef4fb786f3b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Notwithstanding the ceasefire, international human rights law obliges an occupying army to ensure humanitarian aid flows unrestricted into the area they are militarily occupying. Netanyahu is ignoring this obligation altogether.
[Support Humanitarian Aid to Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/6fab073e-5a20-4ffc-ab5f-30481be9d83e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a1f21f5f-fa4d-4d7d-a075-5ae4831ce211?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Worse, the Trump administration just sent another $12 billion in arms to Netanyahu and empowered him to continue his assault. Secretary of State Marco Rubio released a statement last week [that](https://substack.com/redirect/52e92a08-70cb-4efb-8bc2-869ca5cce7ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "_Since taking office, the Trump Administration has approved nearly $12 billion in major FMS sales to Israel_." Again, this notwithstanding that our own US State Department in 2024 confirmed that Netanyahu is not abiding by humanitarian law and is committing war crimes with the weapons sent to him by the Biden Administration.
While it is critical we place pressure on all elected officials to uphold justice and human rights, we can also take meaningful action now to provide relief. I'm partnering with MATW to raise funds for direct aid into Gaza. Especially this Ramadan, I invite you to join by contributing whatever is in your budget. This is a tax deductible donation, and below I share how your funds will be used.
[Support Humanitarian Aid to Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/6fab073e-5a20-4ffc-ab5f-30481be9d83e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **The Aid Trucks for Gaza Initiative 🚛**
The _Aid Trucks for Gaza_ initiative is working tirelessly to provide:
* 🍞 **Food Supplies** : Nutritious meals for families who have lost everything.
* 💧 **Clean Water** : Essential for hydration and hygiene in communities cut off from basic resources.
* 🩺 **Medical Kits** : Life-saving medicines and first aid for the injured and sick.
* 🛏️ **Hygiene & Shelter**: Blankets, hygiene kits, menstrual products, and temporary protection for displaced families.

Through careful planning and coordination, essential supplies are being delivered from Jordan to Gaza using a streamlined and transparent distribution system, ensuring help reaches those who need it most.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/93f1e2d4-7047-4d6f-a5ec-b8e01ff41c79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Support Humanitarian Aid to Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/6fab073e-5a20-4ffc-ab5f-30481be9d83e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **Your Role in the Solution**
Every contribution counts. By supporting this initiative, you can help:
* 🍽 Deliver food packs that sustain families for weeks.
* 💧 Provide clean drinking water to communities in dire need.
* 🏥 Distribute emergency medical care to those injured and unwell.
* ⛺ Offer dignity and safety to displaced families through temporary shelters.

Your generosity directly funds aid trucks loaded with critical supplies, bringing hope and relief to Gaza's most vulnerable.
[Support Humanitarian Aid to Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/6fab073e-5a20-4ffc-ab5f-30481be9d83e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The world is a cruel place, but I firmly believe in the power of human compassion, empathy, sacrifice, and commitment to justice above all else. Whether you can contribute $1 or $1 million, please know that your support is vital towards alleviating suffering and saving lives.
Finally, even if you are not able to contribute anything directly, I would be immensely grateful if you would share this article on your social media and through your networks. United for justice, we can make meaningful progress for those in dire need. Thank you for your trust and partnership.

Chris Murphy, and Liz Shuler on a mass call this Thursday at 8 pm ET to find out how we plan to do that. | | | Peter, Elon Musk is trying to steal our federal government — slashing public services, firing civil servants, and handing power to billionaires like himself. It’s illegal, it’s dangerous, and we won’t stand for it. Here’s what to expect on the call: Hear from federal workers on the frontlines fighting back against illegal DOGE cuts. Learn about our new national campaign of actions and town halls to stop federal worker firings and cuts to public services — and how YOU can get involved. Get insights from top elected officials and union leaders — including AFL-CIO president Liz Shuler and AFGE president Everett Kelley — about the urgent stakes of this battle. Nationwide mass organizing is the only way we’re going to be able to stop and reverse the privatization of our government. Federal workers will be taking action with community members, elected officials and the American people to say: Let Us Work! Save Our Services! The federal government belongs to the American people, not billionaires like Musk. What we’re witnessing now is a corporate coup, designed to break public trust in government and replace public services with profit-driven schemes. [https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/70756F655332783372636F454353396562687376694F485948735343712B763672586D4157707A676459726C636F6733786F6E2B526572766D6752546567474F/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-01-10%20at%208.23.20%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Dear Friends and Supporters,
I hope this message finds you well. Today, I write to you with deep concern regarding the recent dismantling of the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID), an institution that has embodied American compassion and leadership for over six decades.
Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the completion of a six-week purge, resulting in the elimination of approximately 83% of USAID's programs. This drastic reduction affects around 5,200 out of 6,200 programs, many of which have been instrumental in promoting global stability, supporting humanitarian efforts, and fostering goodwill towards the United States.
I need your help to defend it.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/6C686C4954447143785366557665685147374F682F4A762B794B4C46626A7154532F754C67774E624856523730414B53784B767977396C736761614B54447471/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-03-11%20at%201.16.57%E2%80%AFPM.png]
USAID, established over six decades ago, has been a cornerstone of our foreign policy, embodying America's commitment to global leadership and compassion. Programs addressing epidemic control, famine prevention, and democracy promotion have been halted, leaving vulnerable populations without critical support and potentially creating vacuums that adversarial entities may exploit.
The rationale provided for these cuts centers on claims of inefficiency and misalignment with national interests. However, by withdrawing from these commitments, we risk eroding the goodwill and partnerships that have been built over decades, ultimately compromising our national security. The sudden termination of thousands of contracts has led to widespread job losses among aid workers and contractors, both domestically and abroad. This move does not make sense, and we must step up to defend USAID.
We only have 21 days before special elections. If you, too, fear for the state of our government, I urge you to donate to a campaign that cares. Together, with just a $9 donation, we can make a difference come April. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gay2025klemail]

Or, donate another amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gay2025klemail?express_lane_other=true&refcode=express_lane_other]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/6C686C4954447143785366557665685147374F682F4A762B794B4C46626A7154532F754C67774E624856523730414B53784B767977396C736761614B54447471/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-02-12%20at%202.22.12%E2%80%AFPM.png]
It is imperative that we advocate for a foreign policy that balances fiscal responsibility with moral leadership. We must hold our leaders accountable for decisions that have far-reaching implications, not only for those directly affected but also for America's role as a beacon of hope and democracy.
Thank you for your continued support and dedication to these principles.
Sincerely,

body:
Thank you for your support during the last legislative session. We wanted to fill you in on the work of Governing Group's legislators.

| | | | | [](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=5b28639845&e=6484bb6dd5)
---
| | | | | Dear Friend,
The Utah legislative session has officially wrapped. There has been much discussion of the nearly 600 bills passed this year. We wanted to proudly report that **Governing Group-endorsed legislators worked hard to pass meaningful bills that will benefit Utahns in real, tangible ways.**
From ensuring our state parks remain accessible and well-maintained to protecting vulnerable adults, strengthening emergency response, and supporting educators, our endorsed candidates led on issues that matter. **Here are just a few examples of what they accomplished:**

* **Protecting Utah’s most vulnerable** – Rep. Anthony Loubet’s HB 534 strengthens Adult Protective Services' ability to protect those at risk of abuse.

* **Supporting future teachers** – Rep. Karen Peterson’s HB 168 expands stipend opportunities for student teachers, helping recruit and retain great educators in Utah’s classrooms.

* **Boosting emergency response** – Rep. Dave Shallenberger’s HB 150 improves funding and efficiency for Utah’s 911 call centers.

* **Expanding and improving Utah’s state parks** – Rep. Clint Okerlund’s HB 490 ensures long-term development and better management of state parks, while Rep. Steve Eliason’s HB 34 enhances outdoor recreation by allowing for the designation of state campgrounds.

You can hear firsthand from a few of our legislators about their work to improve access to state parks and other outdoor recreational opportunities on KSL NewsRadio.
---

---

Your donation ensures we can keep backing candidates who deliver for Utah.**](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=63273026a3&e=6484bb6dd5)

Governing Group Team

subject: The Democratic Party must still Reject AIPAC!

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

On this day last year, Justice Democrats helped launch the Reject AIPAC
coalition, a broad alliance of progressive groups committed to taking on
the American Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) and its affiliated dark
money Super PACs that lobby Congress for unconditional support for Israel
while spending hundreds of millions of dollars attacking progressive
Pro-Palestinian candidates in Democratic primaries.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250311?refcode=em20250311-36494&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36494_1203867_X88fbQ&akid=36494%2E1203867%2EX88fbQ ]Screenshot of headlines about the Reject AIPAC campaign from March 2024

Over the last two years, we’ve watched AIPAC do everything in its power to
silence growing dissent in Congress against the Netanyahu administration’s
genocide and ethnic cleansing of Palestinians, even as voters continue to
overwhelmingly support a permanent ceasefire and oppose sending more blank
checks to the Israeli military.

The lobby group’s far-right network spent $126.9 million — more money than
ever before — in the 2024 election cycle, especially targeting pro-peace
Representatives Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman in their Democratic primaries
with more money than has ever been spent in a Democratic primary. AIPAC
succeeded in replacing these working-class Squad members with weak,
corporate-backed Democrats who refuse to hold the Israeli and U.S.
governments accountable to federal and international law.

With the impact of November’s massive Democratic losses being felt under a
MAGA super majority right now, the Party must finally learn its lesson and
stop relying on this toxic lobby network for campaign contributions.
AIPAC’s Republican donor-funded Super PAC is no doubt preparing to spend
even more money in the 2026 primaries targeting the remaining
working-class, progressive, Black and brown members of Congress who have
led the calls for an end to US-funded genocide. And they'll keep spending
millions protecting the same Do-Nothing corporate Democrats who work
harder to defend Israel in Congress than defeat Donald Trump and Elon
Musk.

We cannot let a dark money Super PAC that has endorsed 109 insurrectionist
election deniers and over 200 anti-abortion extremists, and is funded by
Trump’s megadonors, continue to undermine our democracy at a time like
this.

AIPAC's spending embodies the corrupt campaign finance system ushered in
by Citizens United — giving billionaires the power to buy Congressional
seats at the expense of the voice of everyday voters.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250311?refcode=em20250311-36494&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36494_1203867_X88fbQ&akid=36494%2E1203867%2EX88fbQ ]Now is the time for the whole of the Democratic Party to Reject AIPAC
once and for all. If you agree, keep up the fight and fuel our work by
making a contribution now →

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250311?refcode=em20250311-36494&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36494_1203867_X88fbQ&akid=36494%2E1203867%2EX88fbQ ]Contribute $5

If our Party wants to earn back the trust of its own base, it cannot keep
taking money from the same right-wing billionaire-funded lobbies and Super
PACs that got us here in the first place.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20250311-36494-footer&t=1002&refcode2=36494_1203867_X88fbQ&akid=36494%2E1203867%2EX88fbQ

And you should be, too.

Khalil is a Syrian-American graduate of Columbia University who helped organize protests against the genocide of Palestinian's in Gaza last year.
A legal permanent resident of the United States, ICE has no authority to arrest Khalil. Khalil broke no laws, and even if he had, those crimes would be prosecuted by the jurisdiction in which they were committed, not by ICE.
Columbia University has engaged in physical and psychological warfare against its own students for nearly 18 months, allowing (and even encouraging) student protestors to be attacked, beaten and arrested for protesting the ongoing genocide and occupation in Gaza by Israeli forces.
Other universities have done the same -- but none to the degree Columbia has now become synonymous with.
ICE kidnapped a legal resident in the middle of the night, then transported him to one of the worst detention facilities in the country -- Jena, Louisiana.
If you are not outraged, you are part of the problem.

name: Kimberly Bretches
subject: They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay
body:
| | | The same city that gave Chance this award is trying to put him in prison for life for doing his job.
---
| |
---
Dear Peter, That's me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches in the picture I've sent you...
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=8cac6b78c5ea4b03a247736d068a2957&_e=SLD1dGxqa4R55HQezMb8Ri4OCcsZCOxQRCupwnzwlD4YmIQXIxuKrJxjd2XEqhZEyKmsSpquqAoo_fj8Luy1fQFU_K6wHX-Wu9R_duonq2Z1aVxf_8jK5h1aPyQpccTaTp0i9mL5GcVtN14vM1DTOXLcOgYHWGV_FWAFkFzucuGI_NFilVpcIORHTvRrRapLduDImIruSFDT9N7ZItiHX_eUgDPFnnCgs2_9SOcL7hWTRIIpRMMLfRxy6wPpf6TLfqgBfTyJbt3kdwXyLr55aK775mkZK4GiiDSwdVrAx5zrw7CKsKk6inVRS4AvORtCJLMoTGHQncdzyGa5UqvAucfBRarWzFWbJCfk1BvcX11CQptkSvJA8Qls8eJVnPM5)
---
...a picture we took on the day Chance received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor for rescuing a driver from a crashed car that had caught on fire. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because in July, the same city that gave Chance this award... ...will try to lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? _**[Would you help by sending a one-time gift to LELDF so this amazing group can defend my husband and the other good police officers who have wrongly accused?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=8cac6b78c5ea4b03a247736d068a2957&_e=SLD1dGxqa4R55HQezMb8Ri4OCcsZCOxQRCupwnzwlD4YmIQXIxuKrJxjd2XEqhZEyKmsSpquqAoo_fj8Luy1fQFU_K6wHX-Wu9R_duonq2Z1aVxf_8jK5h1aPyQpccTaTp0i9mL5GcVtN14vM1DTOXLcOgYHWGV_FWAFkFzucuGI_NFilVpcIORHTvRrRapLduDImIruSFDT9N7ZItiHX_eUgDPFnnCgs2_9SOcL7hVy3uD-DQBHpeTn9CM6jYuteWm00XBd7y3JScuGr2WbOmN-HI39Nu71qNMUohrcmBgMPJejtLb4cem3jbodY5-vFs5ju8vcCKxSuAclDyEXjGu1b491NEabFVkZfqlXPNgZvZujCMQY2zylveOfOX37)**_** ** You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. _**[So with that in mind, please know that any contribution -- be it $35, $100, $500 or even $1,000 -- is tax-deductible.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=8cac6b78c5ea4b03a247736d068a2957&_e=SLD1dGxqa4R55HQezMb8Ri4OCcsZCOxQRCupwnzwlD4YmIQXIxuKrJxjd2XEqhZEyKmsSpquqAoo_fj8Luy1fQFU_K6wHX-Wu9R_duonq2Z1aVxf_8jK5h1aPyQpccTaTp0i9mL5GcVtN14vM1DTOXLcOgYHWGV_FWAFkFzucuGI_NFilVpcIORHTvRrRapLduDImIruSFDT9N7ZItiHX_eUgDPFnnCgs2_9SOcL7hUSEjqICRvM-tK9EL5yc9i_XhCGywsQgbBEhNd3YCZLvVt9o28B7zDmdKvqRESv8t2rLxTwjW_0TMz8XoHefQ53DWCn3bT6QwvCvVPmBI0v9ghIJVRwAByF45p7WhrOChMdjYoWLue9XU2Yj9_WTno7)**_ But whatever you feel led to give, please end it back quickly. Chance's trial starts on July 7th. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he'll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. clean_body: | | | The same city that gave Chance this award is trying to put him in prison for life for doing his job. | | Dear Peter, That's me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches in the picture I've sent you... ...a picture we took on the day Chance received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor for rescuing a driver from a crashed car that had caught on fire. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because in July, the same city that gave Chance this award... ...will try to lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. ## A Fairer Fight
For years the right has fought with one hand behind its back - ok, maybe both.
Now? Not so much.
We are getting closer to a level playing field.
The Democrats have owned it all - Hollywood, corporate America, Big Tech, academia, publishing, the media, the government bureaucracy, etc.
But it also owned the big outside groups who had an impact of public policy and culture - Brookings, ACLU, Southern Poverty Law Center, ActBlue, and even GoFundMe.
Heck even the Human Society and SPCA are run by the LEFT.
But the tide is shifting.
I have noted that these past four years out of office have allowed President Trump to plot a return to power with consequential results. The people, policies and process that have all been planned over the past fours and the results show it.
Beyond that though - the groups on the right are having a MAJOR impact.

**COURIER is standing firm.**
**We don’t answer to profits. We don’t soften our reporting out of fear. And we don’t put the truth behind a paywall.**
Instead, we deliver fact-based, unflinching journalism to millions of Americans where they already are—on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and email, cutting through the noise, the disinformation, and the mainstream media’s cowardice.
In just the past year, we’ve:
* Built a progressive media network reaching nearly 6 million people.
* Generated billions of social media impressions, ensuring the truth reaches those most at risk of disinformation.

| We’re excited to invite you to the **Autism Health Summit** , hosted by Autism Health Inc., a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to improving the lives of individuals and families affected by autism. This transformative event will take place from **April 11-13, 2025, at the beautiful Town and Country Resort in sunny San Diego, CA.** Join us for an incredible weekend filled with knowledge, inspiration, and community. The Autism Health Summit will feature a lineup of renowned speakers who are leaders in autism health and wellness, including **Dr. Peter McCullough, Del Bigtree, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Brian Hooker, Dr. Richard Boles, and many more!** Whether you're a parent, practitioner, or advocate, this event offers something for everyone. We believe that access to valuable resources and education should be available to all. That’s why **Scholarships** are available for low-income families who wish to attend. If you or someone you know qualifies, just fill out the online application [HERE](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=938f4d260f&e=3a42edfdc4). Take advantage of our special offer: **Save $50** on your ticket with promo code **AHS50** at checkout. Don’t wait... this exclusive discount won’t last long, and ticket prices will go up soon. This is your opportunity to gain valuable insights, connect with like-minded individuals, and leave feeling empowered and hopeful for the future. And with San Diego’s beautiful weather and the stunning Town and Country Resort as our host venue, you’ll enjoy not just the event, but also the vibrant surroundings. Click [HERE](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=1f54a29bfc&e=3a42edfdc4) to book your room. **Continuing Medical Education (CME)** are available! Just register under the Professional Track to receive 14 CME credits for medical professionals. Secure your spot today! Click [HERE](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=eb57ff94ac&e=3a42edfdc4) to buy your tickets now and join us for a weekend of learning, growth, and inspiration. We look forward to welcoming you this April! Warm regards,
The Autism Health Team
**Autism Health Inc.**

body:
Will you take a moment to share your thoughts with us?
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250311-1&t=1&akid=1838%2E587540%2ETxRSaj)
Peter,
Obviously, the 2024 election didn’t go the way we had hoped for at the presidential level. We’re dealing with the consequences of that every day as the Trump administration pushes through its chaotic and cruel agenda.
But from Congress to state legislatures across the country, young progressive candidates won important races to make good on the issues that matter most to their constituents — from tackling the climate crisis to working toward a future free of gun violence.
In fact, Leaders We Deserve played an important role in helping to elect six new progressive champions last November: **Sarah McBride, Molly Cook, Bryce Berry, Dante Pittman, Christine Cockley, and Oscar De Los Santos.**
This didn’t come out of nowhere. Since 2023, Leaders We Deserve has been at the forefront of investing in young leaders — cultivating a bench of young progressives who will fight for their communities and help to defeat the far-right’s agenda.
We don’t plan on slowing down either. With Donald Trump back in office, it’s clear that young progressives will be the antidote we need to counter the MAGA GOP.
With that in mind — have you ever thought about running for office, Peter? Yes, you! As we look to the future, you or someone you know could play an important role in shaping this future by running for office. **[If you’ve got a moment, share your thoughts by filling out our quick candidate recruitment survey now!](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/survey/lwd-em-candidate-recruitment-survey/?source=em20250311-1838&amount=5&akid=1838%2E587540%2ETxRSaj)**
**[Candidate Recruitment Survey](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/survey/lwd-em-candidate-recruitment-survey/?source=em20250311-1838&akid=1838%2E587540%2ETxRSaj)**
By electing more young trailblazers to office, we’re breaking down the barriers that have long kept young people away from the table.
We not only identify candidates who will have the biggest impact on their communities — we go even further by providing day-to-day support by building campaigns from the ground up and work with candidates directly on their messaging, fundraising, coalition building, and much more!
Our movement is shaking up the status quo and equipping the next generation of leadership with the tools and resources they need to not only run but to win their races.
And it all begins with folks like you, Peter! **[So if you've ever considered running for office or if you know a young person in your community who should be on our radar, can you take a moment to fill out our candidate recruitment survey?**](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/survey/lwd-em-candidate-recruitment-survey/?source=em20250311-1838&akid=1838%2E587540%2ETxRSaj)

body:
#

Dear friend,
This year we will be hosting our **GIFFORDS Celebration of Courage on March 19th** at a critical moment for the movement to keep our kids and communities safe. We are excited to be joined by **Senator Chris Murphy, Senator Mark Kelly, Congresswoman Lateefa Simon,** local elected leaders and hundreds of supporters for this very important event.
We hope you will join us as we discuss how GIFFORDS and GIFFORDS Law Center will work every day to protect the progress made and outline how we can continue to achieve progress despite the threats the gun violence prevention movement faces under the new Trump administration.
The event includes a reception that begins at 6 pm. The program will begin at 7 pm and is currently slated to end by 8:15 pm. Complimentary parking will be provided on site in the adjacent garage.
[**No contribution is required to attend. You can make a contribution to support our work or learn more about the event by going to our event site here.**](https://giffords.org/2025-annual-celebration//?source=em250311-1-&refcode2=10095.3935704.b6QAd0)
Please let me know if you have any questions.
We hope you will join us as we gather to fight for a safer country without gun violence.
Thanks,
Chris Phillips
GIFFORDS VP of Development

They couldn't even will themselves to clap for 13-year-old cancer survivor DJ Daniels for being sworn in as an honorary member of the Secret Service. If we don’t make up the difference, our conservative mission will be cut short. | | | My situation is in your hands, Peter. I'm writing today to give you an update and to make a humble plea. Look - this is from the bottom of my heart, so please read this message to the end. My team and I put together a historic win in 2021 to help flip all three of Virginia's highest offices red. Ever since becoming Lt. Governor, I've been logging big wins for my friends, neighbors, and every fellow Virginian. Now, I'm running for Governor so we can continue to keep up the amazing work we've been doing here in the Commonwealth and make history again. But right now I have a few SERIOUS challenges: I was legally barred from accepting even a dime in support of my campaign while I was in the Virginia legislative session. But my Democrat opponent, Abigail Spanberger, was fundraising BIG TIME while I was working hard in our capital. Seriously , a far-Left group injected $500K into Abigail Spanberger 's campaign coffers and there wasn't a thing I could do in response! Now Spanberger has an ENORMOUS fundraising advantage, Peter. Polls show this race is tied, but Spanberger has a serious cash advantage.If we don 't make up the difference, our conservative mission will be cut short. Today, I 'm making a plea to you as a Christian, a mother, and a Marine; please send in any amount you can spare to support my campaign! | | Without your support, we will fall even further behind. The Democrat elitists will log a win and our Commonwealth will regress down a path to irreversible socialism!I wouldn't ask you to stay in this fight if I didn't think it was worth it. And Peter, I know we will win if we hold strong and fight this battle together. I am asking you from the bottom of my heart; please stick with me and help us keep the conservative movement thriving! | Republicans are lying, Peter.

The big-budget proposal they narrowly passed last month requires the largest Medicaid cuts in American history – all to give billionaires like Elon Musk $4.5 TRILLION in tax cuts.

And yet, they keep trying to convince the American people otherwise by parroting the same lie that millions of people over the age of 100 are getting benefits. But we know President Trump and his House Republican majority are lying. They’re intent on leaving Americans in the cold as they help the rich get richer.

_This brief is written to provide you an overview of and data relating to America 's incarceration problems as we reach the end of Trump's first two months in office._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..g1eoE7IJ0_sOA920iXfh6PQhOHEJMW4l-zh1IEKVZek?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=158867445)
America's incarceration rate is other-worldly, but it hasn't always been this way.
And the politics of which party is worse on this issue might surprise you.
Ronald Reagan's "War on Drugs" started the United States on a path to becoming the top global industrial prison complex, with arrests, convictions and incarceration rates for Black Americans far outpacing their non-Black peers.
The next three Presidential administrations only worsened the problem.
George Bush Sr.'s 1990 Anti-Drug Abuse Act expanded incarceration of nonviolent drug offenders.
But the number of incarcerated individuals _doubled_ during President Clinton's time in office.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/78a226b9-81c9-487a-a2fb-8b9ad4763059?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Clinton's "criminal reform" bills, including the Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994 and the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act of 1996 -- resulted in the largest increase in incarcerated Americans in history.
Clinton's "three strikes" law mandated life sentences for individuals convicted of three or more offenses -- even nonviolent drug possession charges.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d5530336-eae0-4ecd-8e7b-ed83d8f319bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Clinton also expanded the federal death penalty, bloated the budgets of police departments nationwide, and began the process of prison privatization...

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that Planned Parenthood received **$699 million dollars** from taxpayers in the last reported year? In fact, the abortion corporation has received billions of dollars from the government over the past few decades!

Based on reporting from its 2022-2023 annual report, Planned Parenthood killed approximately 1,076 preborn babies every day, 45 every hour, and one every 80 seconds. Its annual killing rate has increased by 20,000 since the previous reported year.

Thankfully, national leaders are beginning to take notice.

President Trump has chosen Elon Musk to head the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), a new government agency that aims to reduce waste and spending, including potentially pulling federal funding from Planned Parenthood.

Last fall, Elon Musk co-authored an op-ed, published by the Wall Street Journal (WSJ), which said:

_" ...DOGE will help end federal overspending by taking aim at the $500 billion plus in annual federal expenditures that are unauthorized by Congress or being used in ways that Congress never intended, from $535 million a year to the Corporation for Public Broadcasting and $1.5 billion for grants to international organizations to nearly $300 million to progressive groups like Planned Parenthood."_

This is incredibly hopeful news, Friend of Life, but it's not final. “**Federal appeals court reverses Texas death row inmate’s conviction** ,” Houston Chronicle's **Matt deGrood** — "A federal appeals court has tossed an Amarillo woman’s death sentence after it found that local prosecutors had failed to reveal that their primary trial witness was a paid informant.

With a 2-1 decision, the U.S. 5th Circuit Court of Appeals last week sent **Brittany Marlowe Holberg’s** 1998 murder conviction back down to the trial court to decide how to proceed.

Holberg has been on death row for 27 years. In securing her conviction in 1998, Randall County prosecutors heavily relied on testimony from a jail inmate who was working as a confidential informant for the City of Amarillo police. That informant recanted her testimony in 2011, but neither a Texas Court of Criminal Appeals or a federal district court found that prosecutors had violated Holberg’s constitutional right to a fair trial.

The appeals court [disagreed](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.xjnMFfva-73dHOne5Rc0eH94VzLqEqDPtmuAKfWRCNr8tEC5b8cFrHUkrznFg2E3rVIxsncptkbLD--iyKfKhtZ2OVZAdPQGUQv5qSgJXJ4kYMsFYVSna7Y4Fnc2etvhEl4dWEp8-IyASxkRNNRCOFuMgQ-ACwk0G5ihnP3n5jUBq164_LP4BkVjEBqUpS4zzdywq9oWQBKvtTNEzv4U2DcW4cKELNqVw_7N0_MwXvCzpDrzJZcd87dqn47LT87_r_Cuc7Sh9S0VX_P75GVXe1cypa7xMDyGZewkgOo92ZDyDUrn3ZDPtiPcADnUM3nVf8BvoE4VXlC72YPOHAQ72qFr6xfHMQy0m7kzIetq2JbKqossLf2fBLEcdznWxu8gVVYrcyvkBMZcEZAiztztkq6UZBAICMPusjTTeREfOQ_3x3SWh3RNzrlzMaKInWCJadYgqXtY6YOgSw_qe0XZ7XCsMARAGYCM1XCIj_9zsm86p5ioZHDaZulOFp1il8Fm/4ep/ZD4LtNaVRwWSZvHnkApKmA/h23/h001.IkizLP-Xl2L5zQHe5Kxe7UF0zy96apKB5y1uJM2ejv0), saying that the informant was critical to the jury’s determination of guilt and that the prosecution violated Holberg’s due process rights by hiding information that, according to a landmark U.S. Supreme court ruling, must be disclosed. Writing for the majority, judge **Patrick E. Higginbotham** cast Holberg’s case as a blight on the criminal justice system.

“We pause only to acknowledge that 27 years on death row is a reality dimming the light that ought to attend proceedings where a life is at stake, a stark reminder that the jurisprudence of capital punishment remains a work in progress,” wrote Higginbotham, a **Ronald Reagan** appointee.

Holberg was sentenced to death by an Amarillo jury when she was 23 years old. The jury found her guilty of murdering **A.B. Towery** , an 80-year-old man and former client of Holberg, a sex worker. During trial, Holberg asserted that she acted in self-defense and that she stabbed Towery because she feared for her life and sought to protect herself after he struck her on the back of the head and refused to relent.

The prosecution, however, presented testimony from Holberg’s jail cellmate **Vickie Marie Kirkpatrick** , who alleged that Holberg had admitted to killing Towery “in order to get money” and said she “would do it all over again for more drugs.”

Kirkpatrick was at the time working as a confidential informant for the City of Amarillo police, a fact prosecutors did not disclose. They instead presented Kirkpatrick as a “disinterested individual who ‘wanted to do the right thing,’” Higginbotham wrote.

Holberg had experienced severe and repeated sexual abuse during her childhood and fell into a crack cocaine addiction. She turned to sex work to support her addiction, according to court documents.

On Nov. 13, 1996, she had a minor traffic accident and then sought refuge in Towery’s apartment. A heated argument turned violent, leaving Towery dead with part of a lamp lodged within his throat. Holberg left the apartment cut, bruised and bleeding from her head where Towery struck her.

While in jail, the Randall County District Attorney’s Office approached multiple inmates to question them about Holberg, offering them a deal in exchange for testimony. Kirkpatrick, who was placed in the same cell as Holberg, produced a statement detailing an alleged admission from Holberg. That same day, Kirkpatrick was released on bond.

In a lone dissent, circuit judge **Stuart Kyle Duncan** , a **Donald Trump** appointee, wrote that the jury did not solely rely on Kirkpatrick’s testimony to reach their decision of guilt.

“The jury was presented with graphic physical evidence that Holberg sadistically butchered a sick old man—with a lamp rammed down his throat as the coup de grâce,” Duncan wrote. “That evidence doomed Holberg’s self-defense theory and there is no chance that impeaching Kirkpatrick would have resurrected it.”" [AP](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.NqSnJExt2xH2gproqsd7CUXfGl9oh_5LvlVrCsdmEO1zWc2fYx2sRBfPvvXLck7WeWh4jDKCuFrnrn_9KWZYuMRoK8VWEW-Mpp13R5nZUVCED5RpYMDjukVjVsFNo8xRAmDe-Ulxd8VqH-kKkQmWqbIcAnG3OFHL_0jMiC6apJxFFAgHUBNRXrfLKNskjWd3Bv28PgDSdFDGMUhLO7AecvGCDvpNT-h3WN8kViRuUqSlik9pcsxhQKFMpx8aKjpx9psgsAsTELDRSHSodFo6dGDl5lNKHv-ph-WqY7PEI1340u0H0l5xG3KDnraGo3vjuVtR4s4PzXBb7geReZWEvU6nkFQze-8GSvIY2sjHCwpEojXoWKSQeySFYOlvsp1tVFCJ2yt3kpgummViyMrtF2gcUxT0IsgVhXnyGmaCeZAvoWUnQvXQA5HQGCM4RzZJIe8cBmuC5yHdJavCVHKspbf44eQAMUSJGxkuwyCahfbBnhNLGEKWR9-81QjICTgoEBlB-QrSGc-iwhO5DcyasdsxBlQKNhiAYNJeGOaGkkVq-7BVYkiwMoDPh8pe1Fm41liBJPLqNsooQkQf66GEEqqmhIMKHKUUPBqpfjzyrPwMwPVvyBKkc5Wz-QTdBf0c7gjbOZSrxBSI4n3ol6S82Q/4ep/ZD4LtNaVRwWSZvHnkApKmA/h24/h001.w-7H6y7kpmd6IptP-1ew2UHf9L_BfkjAJW6iRnMD8XE)

“**Williamson County Judge Bill Gravell resigns to take position in Trump administration** ,” Austin American-Statesman's **Claire Osborn** — “Williamson County Judge **Bill Gravell** resigned Tuesday to take a position with the Trump administration as the Region 6 advocate for the U.S. Small Business Administration's office of advocacy.

Gravell said he applied for the Region 6 position, which covers Texas, New Mexico, Arkansas, Louisiana and Oklahoma, because he felt like he had done a good job in helping small businesses thrive in the county.

"For me this is just a continuation of what I was doing in Williamson County but on a larger scale," Gravell said. "I learned during COVID that the backbone to Williamson County was our small businesses."

In the past six years, he said, the county has handled 12,500 small business applications. It also saw the expansion of major corporations such as Apple, Samsung and Kalahari Resorts.

Gravell, 61, announced his resignation at the Commissioners Court meeting. District Judge **Betsy Lambeth** swore Gravell into his new office as advocate a few minutes after Gravell resigned.

“It is a great honor to serve as the voice for the 4.5 million small businesses that make the South-Central region of the United States their home,” Gravell said. “Growing up at 1402 East Main Street in Round Rock, Texas, I never could have imagined that one day I would have the opportunity to serve the United States. This is truly an honor, but I will never forget where I came from."

The commissioners will appoint a new county judge to serve until the next general election on Nov. 3, 2026. They will hold a special session at 11 a.m. Friday to accept Gravell’s resignation and to discuss the appointment of the new county judge.

Gravell said the county has prospered in the six years he has been judge with the appraised value growing from $84 billion to $180 billion. Gravell, a former youth pastor and justice of the peace, was sworn in as county judge Jan. 1, 2019. He won re-election in 2022.

As county judge, Gravell served as the director of emergency management during local disasters, navigating several crises through his tenure, according to a county news release. Those crises included the COVID-19 pandemic, tornadoes, fires and the deadly February 2021 freeze, Gravell said. Gravell said his new job, which has just started, involves being an advocate for small businesses to make sure new rules and regulations they might face don't damage them, he said. Gravell said he would remain based in Georgetown with some traveling to other states.

Gravell was in his second term as county judge when he resigned. He served from 2013-2018 as a justice of the peace and also served for 22 years as a youth pastor.

Become a PAID subscriber for $5/mo or $50/yr . | TOP NEWS “Texas measles outbreak grows to 223 cases, with another 30 in New Mexico ,” Houston Chronicle's Evan McDonald — “A grew to 223 cases on Tuesday, with another 30 cases reported in New Mexico, according to health officials. The from the Texas Department of State Health Services includes 25 new cases since the agency’s last update on Friday. Twenty-nine people have been hospitalized and one child has died, the . The outbreak continues to be concentrated in children who have not received the vaccine that protects against measles, mumps and rubella, or whose vaccination status is unknown. Nearly 70% of the cases have been in Gaines County, a small county along the New Mexico border. All 30 cases in New Mexico have been in Lea County, located just across the border from Gaines County. The New Mexico Department of Health reported last week that an unvaccinated adult , the second death associated with the outbreak. Doctors and public health experts have said the outbreak, which began in late January, could continue to spread for some time. Measles is highly contagious, and it can take seven to 21 days for symptoms to appear after an exposure. » Doctors have stressed the MMR vaccine is the most effective way to prevent measles. One dose is 93% effective at preventing an infection, while two doses are 97% effective, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. “The best way to prevent measles, and to prevent the complications of measles, is to be protected against it,” Dr. Pedro Piedra , a pediatrician and infectious disease specialist at Baylor College of Medicine, said Friday during a forum hosted by the Texas Epidemic Public Health Institute. “And vaccination is the best method for prevention.” » Gaines County reported an additional 19 cases since Friday, according to DSHS data. The county has now reported 156 cases, about 70% of all cases in the outbreak. Terry County reported three new cases, bringing its total to 32. Yoakum County reported two new cases, bringing its total to 10. Dawson County reported one new case, bringing its total to 10. Five other counties have reported cases amid the outbreak, but did not report any new infections since Friday. Dallam County has reported five cases, both Lubbock and Martin counties have reported three and both Ector and Lynn have reported two. Most cases have been in children and teens, with 76 in children younger than 5 years old and 98 in children and teens between 5 and 17, according to DSHS data. Only five of the cases have been in people confirmed to have received the MMR vaccine. Eighty have been in unvaccinated individuals, and 138 have been in people whose vaccination status is unknown, according to DSHS data." Sylvester Turner at Houston City Hall ,” Houston Chronicle's Abby Church — “AtSylvester Turner’s meeting as mayor, he took time to talk about his legacy. No other mayor had dealt with what he faced, from the vast number of federally declared national disasters to rising pension costs to social unrest, he told the council at the time. But, Turner added, there was something about knowing what he brought to the table. “You have to know your value. You have to know what you have done. And if you know what you have done, then you can move forward with the assurance that all is well,” Turner said in December 2023. On Tuesday, Houston City Hall welcomed Turner for a final time to honor that legacy by allowing him to lie in state in the rotunda. Turner, who served two terms as Houston’s mayor from 2016-2023 and was recently elected to the U.S. House, after “enduring health complications,” his family said. He was 70. He is only the third person to lie in state at Houston City Hall, joining his friend U.S. Rep. Sheila Jackson Lee on the list of honorees, as well as Michael DeBakey , a renowned heart surgeon. “What was special about Sylvester, he had that can-do attitude that so many of us present have,” current Houston Mayor John Whitmire said to a sea of elected officials and colleagues in front of the city hall steps who came to honor Turner. “He would work with anyone for the benefit of his community.” Turner took over the congressional seat for Jackson Lee, who died at 74 in July, following a battle with pancreatic cancer. Former U.S. Rep. Erica Lee Carter , Jackson Lee’s daughter, won the special election to Turner took the reins in January. The evening before his passing, Turner attended President Donald Trump’s speech to a joint session of the U.S. Congress. In a video , the congressman told the administration, “Don’t mess with Medicaid,” alongside guest Angela Hernandez , a Houstonian advocating for her daughter. Turner’s family said he was taken to the hospital and released following the president’s speech. First responders found him dead inside his Washington apartment the next morning. Just as dawn broke early Tuesday, Turner’s American flag shrouded casket was brought into city hall through the door off McKinney Street. The building was lit up a brilliant blue in his honor – Turner’s team always wore blue on the important days, his longtime aideJeff Syptak said. It was also one of Turner's favorite colors." ($) “Federal appeals court reverses Texas death row inmate’s conviction ,” Houston Chronicle's Matt deGrood — "A federal appeals court has tossed an Amarillo woman’s death sentence after it found that local prosecutors had failed to reveal that their primary trial witness was a paid informant. With a 2-1 decision, the U.S. 5th Circuit Court of Appeals last week sent Brittany Marlowe Holberg’s 1998 murder conviction back down to the trial court to decide how to proceed. Holberg has been on death row for 27 years. In securing her conviction in 1998, Randall County prosecutors heavily relied on testimony from a jail inmate who was working as a confidential informant for the City of Amarillo police. That informant recanted her testimony in 2011, but neither a Texas Court of Criminal Appeals or a federal district court found that prosecutors had violated Holberg’s constitutional right to a fair trial. The appeals court , saying that the informant was critical to the jury’s determination of guilt and that the prosecution violated Holberg’s due process rights by hiding information that, according to a landmark U.S. Supreme court ruling, must be disclosed. Writing for the majority, judge Patrick E. Higginbotham cast Holberg’s case as a blight on the criminal justice system. “We pause only to acknowledge that 27 years on death row is a reality dimming the light that ought to attend proceedings where a life is at stake, a stark reminder that the jurisprudence of capital punishment remains a work in progress,” wrote Higginbotham, a Ronald Reagan appointee. Holberg was sentenced to death by an Amarillo jury when she was 23 years old. The jury found her guilty of murdering A.B. Towery , an 80-year-old man and former client of Holberg, a sex worker. During trial, Holberg asserted that she acted in self-defense and that she stabbed Towery because she feared for her life and sought to protect herself after he struck her on the back of the head and refused to relent. The prosecution, however, presented testimony from Holberg’s jail cellmate Vickie Marie Kirkpatrick , who alleged that Holberg had admitted to killing Towery “in order to get money” and said she “would do it all over again for more drugs.” Kirkpatrick was at the time working as a confidential informant for the City of Amarillo police, a fact prosecutors did not disclose. They instead presented Kirkpatrick as a “disinterested individual who ‘wanted to do the right thing,’” Higginbotham wrote. Holberg had experienced severe and repeated sexual abuse during her childhood and fell into a crack cocaine addiction. She turned to sex work to support her addiction, according to court documents. On Nov. 13, 1996, she had a minor traffic accident and then sought refuge in Towery’s apartment. A heated argument turned violent, leaving Towery dead with part of a lamp lodged within his throat. Holberg left the apartment cut, bruised and bleeding from her head where Towery struck her. While in jail, the Randall County District Attorney’s Office approached multiple inmates to question them about Holberg, offering them a deal in exchange for testimony. Kirkpatrick, who was placed in the same cell as Holberg, produced a statement detailing an alleged admission from Holberg. That same day, Kirkpatrick was released on bond. In a lone dissent, circuit judge Stuart Kyle Duncan , a Donald Trump appointee, wrote that the jury did not solely rely on Kirkpatrick’s testimony to reach their decision of guilt. “The jury was presented with graphic physical evidence that Holberg sadistically butchered a sick old man—with a lamp rammed down his throat as the coup de grâce,” Duncan wrote. “That evidence doomed Holberg’s self-defense theory and there is no chance that impeaching Kirkpatrick would have resurrected it.”" | #TXLEGE “Democrats dubious as Texas House begins work on bill using public money for private school ,” Dallas Morning News' Phil Jankowski — “A public hearing on the Texas Legislature’s most politically charged issue began Tuesday with tough questions from Democratic lawmakers skeptical of a bill that would allow taxpayer dollars to be spent on private school education. At a House committee hearing on House Bill 3, several hundred people were at the Capitol, awaiting their chance to tell lawmakers in Austin what they think about the bill. Protesters rallied outside the Capitol and Gov. Greg Abbott made his case for school choice at a conservative think tank several blocks away. Abbott has made passing an education savings account bill his top legislative priority. Democrats are largely opposed. Before the hearing began, state officials released a cost estimate of the bill, which would provide about $10,500 in an education savings account to qualifying parents who send their children to private schools. showed a sharply increasing cost of the program, which would grow from an initial price tag of $1 billion in 2026 to nearly $4 billion in 2030. Democratic lawmakers peppered the bill’s author, Rep. Brad Buckley , R-Salado, with questions about the bill. Buckley has on several occasions referred to the bill as “empowering parents” to seek the best education for their children. Democrats focused on the program’s universal access, which allows parents of all households to apply for state assistance to pay for private school education. The bill creates prioritized access based on income levels if more parents apply than funds are available. Rep. James Talarico , D-Austin, called for limiting the availability of education savings accounts to low- and middle-income families. “I resent the effort to use parents as a shield for this privatization effort,” Talarico said. Four Democrats on the House committee considering the bill, including Talarico and Dallas Democratic Rep. John Bryant , called on billionaire megadonor Jeff Yass to testify at Tuesday’s hearing. Yass gave as the governor worked to oust House Republicans who opposed a similar bill in 2023. Abbott now believes he to pass his after his endorsed candidates defeated many of those incumbents in the 2024 GOP primary. Supporters say education savings accounts give parents greater control over their child’s education and would enable many to move their children to higher performing private schools they might not be able to afford. Opponents say education savings accounts are the first step in the privatization of public education and are an end run to cut state funding to public schools by reducing enrollment. As Abbott made his late-morning appearance before the Texas Public Policy Foundation, the Texas Freedom Network, a group that supports public education, held a Capitol rally to protest the voucher-style bill. “We will not accept the defunding of our neighborhood schools without a fight,” said Zeph Capo , president of Texas American Federation of Teachers during the rally of about 30 public education advocates. Capo said Abbott and wealthy megadonors were trying to funnel tax dollars to private schools, which would hurt public education. “Make no mistake, this is an attack on public schools,” he said. “It is the playbook we all know too well: Starve schools of resources, shame them for failing to meet unrealistic expectations, and shutter and privatize them.” The its version of an education savings account bill. It would give about $10,000 to per student to help pay for private school education. The accounts would be open to all students, but should costs exceed $1 billion, the bill would prioritize special education students, students with disabilities and students with a household income of up to five times the federal poverty level, about $160,750 for a family of four. The size of an education savings account in HB 3 is set at 85% of state and local money spent on the average student, which based on 2024 figures from the Texas Education Agency comes to about $10,983. Both proposals allow for an education savings account to be used on private school tuition, uniforms, textbooks and tutoring." ($) | LOCAL GOVERNMENT “Williamson County Judge Bill Gravell resigns to take position in Trump administration ,” Austin American-Statesman's Claire Osborn — “Williamson County Judge Bill Gravell resigned Tuesday to take a position with the Trump administration as the Region 6 advocate for the U.S. Small Business Administration's office of advocacy. Gravell said he applied for the Region 6 position, which covers Texas, New Mexico, Arkansas, Louisiana and Oklahoma, because he felt like he had done a good job in helping small businesses thrive in the county. "For me this is just a continuation of what I was doing in Williamson County but on a larger scale," Gravell said. "I learned during COVID that the backbone to Williamson County was our small businesses." In the past six years, he said, the county has handled 12,500 small business applications. It also saw the expansion of major corporations such as Apple, Samsung and Kalahari Resorts. Gravell, 61, announced his resignation at the Commissioners Court meeting. District Judge Betsy Lambeth swore Gravell into his new office as advocate a few minutes after Gravell resigned. “It is a great honor to serve as the voice for the 4.5 million small businesses that make the South-Central region of the United States their home,” Gravell said. “Growing up at 1402 East Main Street in Round Rock, Texas, I never could have imagined that one day I would have the opportunity to serve the United States. This is truly an honor, but I will never forget where I came from." The commissioners will appoint a new county judge to serve until the next general election on Nov. 3, 2026. They will hold a special session at 11 a.m. Friday to accept Gravell’s resignation and to discuss the appointment of the new county judge. Gravell said the county has prospered in the six years he has been judge with the appraised value growing from $84 billion to $180 billion. Gravell, a former youth pastor and justice of the peace, was sworn in as county judge Jan. 1, 2019. He won re-election in 2022. As county judge, Gravell served as the director of emergency management during local disasters, navigating several crises through his tenure, according to a county news release. Those crises included the COVID-19 pandemic, tornadoes, fires and the deadly February 2021 freeze, Gravell said. His greatest accomplishment as judge, he said, was leading "during some of the most complex and difficult times our county has ever faced." "I have strived daily to protect our citizens and the future of our citizens," Gravell said. ... Gravell said his new job, which has just started, involves being an advocate for small businesses to make sure new rules and regulations they might face don't damage them, he said. Gravell said he would remain based in Georgetown with some traveling to other states. Gravell was in his second term as county judge when he resigned. He served from 2013-2018 as a justice of the peace and also served for 22 years as a youth pastor. "I'd like to say to the young people and to my grandchildren," Gravell said on Tuesday, "no matter where your start in life, with hard work, with dedication and with following the Lord you can go anywhere. ... America is still the land of opportunity and I've proven that."" ($) | 2026 “Mayra Guillén, sister of Vanessa Guillén, eyeing a challenge to Houston Rep. Tuesday, March 11, 2025 | Peter -- To start, we know that there’s a lot going on in our country right now, and that many of us feel as if we have no control over the future. Many have been hoping for major changes in our government—so have we!—but don’t believe that what we’re currently seeing is the right kind of change. We feel that, when so much can’t be controlled, it’s good to focus on the things that we can do to bring about the change that we hope to see in America. On that note, thank you to everyone who submitted feedback to us through our end-of-year email series. We took our internal and state debriefs seriously, and we appreciate the feedback that we received to our write-ups following those conversations. So what did we do with this information, and what’s next? First, we took the internal debriefs and the feedback that everyone submitted and put together a presentation for the Forward Party Board of Directors. That group gathered together in January to discuss lessons learned from 2024 and what the future holds for Forward. For a full rundown of the feedback we received, [please read our brief here](https://www.forwardparty.com/media/blog/what-we-learned-in-2024-and-what-were-doing-in-2025/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_54&n=2)! Second, we took the directives of the Board to a staff retreat at the end of January. With the whole team in one room, we were able to talk through our goals through the ‘28 cycle, planning for the future and allowing ourselves time to build. With that in mind, we’ve been working through what that means for our work over the next few years. Look to a follow up next week where we discuss those plans!

I’ll be honest with you, though. If the richest man on Earth is lining up against me, it’s going to take a big team to fight back.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: A billionaire takeover
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Fundamentally, tax policy is about something broader.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2502%2E4032634%2E6rsGUd)
---
When some people hear the words “tax policy,” their minds immediately jump to percentages and dollar amounts and spreadsheets. But fundamentally, tax policy is about something broader. It’s about who our government works for. Does our government only work for billionaires and billionaire corporations, or does it work for everybody? Does our tax system reward the rich, or does it look out for someone who’s putting together two or three jobs just to keep their family above water? Do our laws prioritize helping billionaires boost their bank balances, or do we make sure we can fund nursing homes for seniors, and aides for public school students with disabilities? Tax policy is also about who pitches in to keep our country running. I’m sick of billionaires skipping out on the bill while hard-working Americans — teachers, nurses, firefighters — pay what they owe, year in and year out. And tax policy binds together many, many of the issues we care about. Look, if you care about our climate, if you care about making health care affordable, if you care about the future of our children, if you care about housing, if you care about expanding opportunity, then you have to care about our tax code. **I’m bringing this up right now because Washington has major decisions to make about tax laws.** Donald Trump’s tax breaks for the rich that he passed in 2017 — mostly sucked up by millionaires, billionaires, and giant corporations — are set to expire. And Congressional Republicans are working to extend them — following Trump’s lead, who promised to cut taxes for his “rich as hell” donors. Of course, tax cuts aren’t free, no matter how hard Republicans try to fudge the numbers. Math is math. So while the GOP gets ready to give handouts to the wealthy, Elon Musk works from the inside to free up room in the budget with his illegal funding cuts. He’s targeting everyone from the public servants who make sure your dad gets his Social Security check on time to the scientists who could come up with the next big lifesaving breakthrough. And Congressional Republicans are charging forward with proposed budget cuts that would hurt every community in America. Take Medicaid, which would be gutted under the Republicans’ plans. It covers more than 79 million people, including almost 2 million people in Massachusetts. About half of all births are covered by Medicaid. Over a third of all children have health care thanks to Medicaid. More than half of all nursing home residents are covered by Medicaid. Many people are counting on Medicaid to pay for medicine that treats their cancer, the hip replacement they need to walk, the prescription for their child’s inhaler, or the nursing home that takes care of their uncle with dementia. If the program is cut, the harm will echo through nearly every home in America. But Congressional Republicans seem to think that’s a-okay if it means a billionaire can get a tax break. Billionaires win. Families lose. That’s their plan. You can fit it on a bumper sticker. Help seeing a doctor, help covering grocery bills, help getting an education if you come from a family that can’t write a big tuition check — it’s all under attack from Congressional Republicans. They want to increase costs for health care, food, and education for working people so they can decrease taxes for millionaires, billionaires, and giant corporations. They want to reach into working people’s pockets to pay for billionaires’ handouts. Taxes reflect our values. Taxes show what — and who — we value enough to collectively invest in. And Republicans are showing, pure and simple, that they value a handful of the wealthy and well-connected. Not the working people they claim to represent. And they don’t want you to notice what they’re doing. Newsflash: We are paying attention. In the U.S. Senate, I’ll keep calling out GOP plans to slash taxes for the rich. I’ll keep putting forward plans to protect working families from devastating cuts. And I’ll keep fighting to make our government work not just for the wealthy and well-connected but everybody. And I won’t be alone. **People like you are raising your voices around the country — at town halls, on the phone lines, at local organizing events, at protests — and exposing the Republican agenda. If we can grow and sustain our momentum, we can create enough pressure in Congress and from the public to stop the Republican Party from handing billions more dollars to billionaires with a bunch of billions already.** Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

**I just launched my campaign to be California 's next governor.**
I didn't make this decision lightly. But with an emboldened Trump in the White House and MAGA loyalists doing his bidding day in and day out, California--and our country--need a leader who is ready to go toe to toe with extremists. You can watch my launch video here:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/58585941-061e-45fa-b482-790610bbc764?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I first ran for office in 2018. I was a single mom of three little kids, running in a district that Republicans had held for decades.**But I ran because I couldn 't sit on the sidelines as I watched Trump try and destroy our country.** As a consumer protection attorney, I wanted to use my experience to hold him and his administration accountable.
With the support of folks like you, I made it to Congress, where I was able to save patients thousands of dollars from drug companies who were ripping us off, and passed a law cracking down on health care companies that wrongfully denied care. You may also know me as the 'whiteboard lady,' because I used a whiteboard to call our greed and corruption.
**With Trump and his cronies chipping away at our rights every single day, I feel the same call to serve now that I did during Trump 's first term.**
California is experiencing real challenges. We must become resilient to natural disasters and tackle climate change. We must address the high cost of housing, health care, and groceries. And we must continue to protect our LGBTQ+ community members and safeguard abortion access.
One of my top priorities will be standing up to Donald Trump and protecting Californians. When Trump threatens Californians--whether it's by withholding disaster aid or dismantling health care--I'll always stand up to his bullying and fight back.
**We don 't have to choose between defending our values and tackling our challenges. **We can work with businesses to create good paying jobs in California and hold corporations accountable. We can keep communities safe and uphold civil rights.
I'm never one for BS or sugar coating, so I'll be honest-- this race won't be a walk in the park! There are already multiple candidates in the race to succeed Governor Newsom, who is term-limited, and the primary election is just over a year away.
**I 'm asking you to join our movement to stand up to Trump and his cronies. **In each race I've run, I've rejected corporate PAC money, and that's not changing today. Every donation from a real person like yourself makes a real difference, and is the only way I can win this race: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp-substack](https://substack.com/redirect/58585941-061e-45fa-b482-790610bbc764?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
