"**Williamson County Judge Bill Gravell resigns to take position in Trump administration** ," Austin American-Statesman's **Claire Osborn** -- "Williamson County Judge **Bill Gravell** resigned Tuesday to take a position with the Trump administration as the Region 6 advocate for the U.S. Small Business Administration's office of advocacy.

Gravell said he applied for the Region 6 position, which covers Texas, New Mexico, Arkansas, Louisiana and Oklahoma, because he felt like he had done a good job in helping small businesses thrive in the county.

"For me this is just a continuation of what I was doing in Williamson County but on a larger scale," Gravell said. "I learned during COVID that the backbone to Williamson County was our small businesses."

In the past six years, he said, the county has handled 12,500 small business applications. It also saw the expansion of major corporations such as Apple, Samsung and Kalahari Resorts.

Gravell, 61, announced his resignation at the Commissioners Court meeting. District Judge **Betsy Lambeth** swore Gravell into his new office as advocate a few minutes after Gravell resigned.

"It is a great honor to serve as the voice for the 4.5 million small businesses that make the South-Central region of the United States their home," Gravell said. "Growing up at 1402 East Main Street in Round Rock, Texas, I never could have imagined that one day I would have the opportunity to serve the United States. This is truly an honor, but I will never forget where I came from."

The commissioners will appoint a new county judge to serve until the next general election on Nov. 3, 2026. They will hold a special session at 11 a.m. Friday to accept Gravell's resignation and to discuss the appointment of the new county judge.

Gravell said the county has prospered in the six years he has been judge with the appraised value growing from $84 billion to $180 billion. Gravell, a former youth pastor and justice of the peace, was sworn in as county judge Jan. 1, 2019. He won re-election in 2022.

As county judge, Gravell served as the director of emergency management during local disasters, navigating several crises through his tenure, according to a county news release. Those crises included the COVID-19 pandemic, tornadoes, fires and the deadly February 2021 freeze, Gravell said. His greatest accomplishment as judge, he said, was leading "during some of the most complex and difficult times our county has ever faced."

"I have strived daily to protect our citizens and the future of our citizens," Gravell said. ...

Gravell said his new job, which has just started, involves being an advocate for small businesses to make sure new rules and regulations they might face don't damage them, he said. Gravell said he would remain based in Georgetown with some traveling to other states.

Gravell was in his second term as county judge when he resigned. He served from 2013-2018 as a justice of the peace and also served for 22 years as a youth pastor.

"I'd like to say to the young people and to my grandchildren," Gravell said on Tuesday, "no matter where your start in life, with hard work, with dedication and with following the Lord you can go anywhere. ... America is still the land of opportunity and I've proven that."" "**Southwest Airlines plans to end its free checked bag policy for some travelers** ," Houston Chronicle's **Octavia Johnson** -- "[Southwest Airlines is changing](https://substack.com/redirect/aa90de49-b0a1-499d-90cd-fd602c3905cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its bag policy and will being requiring travelers who don't qualify for free bag options to pay for their first two bags at check-in.

This comes months after the Texas-based airline [ditched its first-come-first-serve seating](https://substack.com/redirect/560d04d9-d737-44a7-b14f-7968772c61bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as one of the company's efforts to keep and attract customers amid its financial struggles.

Southwest will begin charging customers for the first and second checked bags May 28, according to a news release. Travelers on the A-list loyalty program (preferred status member) or using business fare will not have to pay the checked bag fees.

"We have tremendous opportunity to meet current and future Customer needs, attract new Customer segments we don't compete for today, and return to the levels of profitability that both we and our Shareholders expect," said **Bob Jordan** , president and chief executive officer of Southwest, in a statement.

The fee amount for checked bags was unclear as of Tuesday morning.

The airline also announced adjustments to the Rapid Rewards points earned by travelers on qualifying flights, the release reads. Travelers can earn more points on business fares. The loyalty program will also introduce variable redemption rates across higher- and lower-demand flights, according to the release.

Flights and fare products will be available to book on the third-party online travel agency Expedia.

"We will do all this while remaining focused on what's made us strong -- our people and the authentic, friendly, and award-winning Customer Service only they can provide," Jordan said in a statement.

Last year, Jordan initially told investors there were no plans to charge for the first two bags, [CNN reported](https://substack.com/redirect/7ce86f1f-111f-499e-894c-96e5254e4e0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He said the free bag check-in was why customers chose Southwest.

Other initiatives consist of implementing assigned seating, extra legroom options and the airline's first-ever scheduled overnight redeye flights.

The changes at Southwest have been introduced after activist investor Elliot Investment Management called for changes to leadership and operations in hopes of improving the airline financially.

Since then, the airline has [offered buyouts for certain airports](https://substack.com/redirect/2460da8b-06b4-482f-b047-7517c88c2c28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), except in Houston, and [slashed 15% of corporate-level leadership jobs](https://substack.com/redirect/2b8f18cf-181a-495d-a284-e3000e1cfa56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." TOP NEWS "Texas measles outbreak grows to 223 cases, with another 30 in New Mexico ," Houston Chronicle's Evan McDonald -- "A grew to 223 cases on Tuesday, with another 30 cases reported in New Mexico, according to health officials. The from the Texas Department of State Health Services includes 25 new cases since the agency's last update on Friday. Twenty-nine people have been hospitalized and one child has died, the . The outbreak continues to be concentrated in children who have not received the vaccine that protects against measles, mumps and rubella, or whose vaccination status is unknown. Nearly 70% of the cases have been in Gaines County, a small county along the New Mexico border. All 30 cases in New Mexico have been in Lea County, located just across the border from Gaines County. The New Mexico Department of Health reported last week that an unvaccinated adult , the second death associated with the outbreak. Doctors and public health experts have said the outbreak, which began in late January, could continue to spread for some time. Measles is highly contagious, and it can take seven to 21 days for symptoms to appear after an exposure. Doctors have stressed the MMR vaccine is the most effective way to prevent measles. One dose is 93% effective at preventing an infection, while two doses are 97% effective, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. "The best way to prevent measles, and to prevent the complications of measles, is to be protected against it," Dr. Pedro Piedra , a pediatrician and infectious disease specialist at Baylor College of Medicine, said Friday during a forum hosted by the Texas Epidemic Public Health Institute. "And vaccination is the best method for prevention." Gaines County reported an additional 19 cases since Friday, according to DSHS data. The county has now reported 156 cases, about 70% of all cases in the outbreak. Terry County reported three new cases, bringing its total to 32. Yoakum County reported two new cases, bringing its total to 10. Dawson County reported one new case, bringing its total to 10. Five other counties have reported cases amid the outbreak, but did not report any new infections since Friday. Dallam County has reported five cases, both Lubbock and Martin counties have reported three and both Ector and Lynn have reported two. Most cases have been in children and teens, with 76 in children younger than 5 years old and 98 in children and teens between 5 and 17, according to DSHS data. Only five of the cases have been in people confirmed to have received the MMR vaccine. Eighty have been in unvaccinated individuals, and 138 have been in people whose vaccination status is unknown, according to DSHS data." "Residents, elected officials honor former mayor, U.S. Rep. Sylvester Turner at Houston City Hall ," Houston Chronicle's Abby Church -- "AtSylvester Turner 's meeting as mayor, he took time to talk about his legacy. No other mayor had dealt with what he faced, from the vast number of federally declared national disasters to rising pension costs to social unrest, he told the council at the time. But, Turner added, there was something about knowing what he brought to the table. "You have to know your value. You have to know what you have done. And if you know what you have done, then you can move forward with the assurance that all is well," Turner said in December 2023. On Tuesday, Houston City Hall welcomed Turner for a final time to honor that legacy by allowing him to lie in state in the rotunda. Turner, who served two terms as Houston's mayor from 2016-2023 and was recently elected to the U.S. House, after "enduring health complications," his family said. He was 70. He is only the third person to lie in state at Houston City Hall, joining his friend U.S. Rep. Sheila Jackson Lee on the list of honorees, as well as Michael DeBakey , a renowned heart surgeon. "What was special about Sylvester, he had that can-do attitude that so many of us present have," current Houston Mayor John Whitmire said to a sea of elected officials and colleagues in front of the city hall steps who came to honor Turner. "He would work with anyone for the benefit of his community." Turner took over the congressional seat for Jackson Lee, who died at 74 in July, following a battle with pancreatic cancer. Former U.S. Rep. Erica Lee Carter , Jackson Lee's daughter, won the special election to Turner took the reins in January. The evening before his passing, Turner attended President Donald Trump 's speech to a joint session of the U.S. Congress. In a video , the congressman told the administration, "Don't mess with Medicaid," alongside guest Angela Hernandez , a Houstonian advocating for her daughter. Turner's family said he was taken to the hospital and released following the president's speech. First responders found him dead inside his Washington apartment the next morning. Just as dawn broke early Tuesday, Turner's American flag shrouded casket was brought into city hall through the door off McKinney Street. The building was lit up a brilliant blue in his honor - Turner's team always wore blue on the important days, his longtime aideJeff Syptak said. It was also one of Turner's favorite colors." ($) "Federal appeals court reverses Texas death row inmate 's conviction," Houston Chronicle's Matt deGrood -- "A federal appeals court has tossed an Amarillo woman's death sentence after it found that local prosecutors had failed to reveal that their primary trial witness was a paid informant. With a 2-1 decision, the U.S. 5th Circuit Court of Appeals last week sent Brittany Marlowe Holberg 's 1998 murder conviction back down to the trial court to decide how to proceed. Holberg has been on death row for 27 years. In securing her conviction in 1998, Randall County prosecutors heavily relied on testimony from a jail inmate who was working as a confidential informant for the City of Amarillo police. That informant recanted her testimony in 2011, but neither a Texas Court of Criminal Appeals or a federal district court found that prosecutors had violated Holberg's constitutional right to a fair trial. The appeals court , saying that the informant was critical to the jury's determination of guilt and that the prosecution violated Holberg's due process rights by hiding information that, according to a landmark U.S. Supreme court ruling, must be disclosed. Writing for the majority, judge Patrick E. Higginbotham cast Holberg's case as a blight on the criminal justice system. "We pause only to acknowledge that 27 years on death row is a reality dimming the light that ought to attend proceedings where a life is at stake, a stark reminder that the jurisprudence of capital punishment remains a work in progress," wrote Higginbotham, a Ronald Reagan appointee. Holberg was sentenced to death by an Amarillo jury when she was 23 years old. The jury found her guilty of murdering A.B. Towery , an 80-year-old man and former client of Holberg, a sex worker. During trial, Holberg asserted that she acted in self-defense and that she stabbed Towery because she feared for her life and sought to protect herself after he struck her on the back of the head and refused to relent. The prosecution, however, presented testimony from Holberg's jail cellmate Vickie Marie Kirkpatrick , who alleged that Holberg had admitted to killing Towery "in order to get money" and said she "would do it all over again for more drugs." Kirkpatrick was at the time working as a confidential informant for the City of Amarillo police, a fact prosecutors did not disclose. They instead presented Kirkpatrick as a "disinterested individual who 'wanted to do the right thing,'" Higginbotham wrote. Holberg had experienced severe and repeated sexual abuse during her childhood and fell into a crack cocaine addiction. She turned to sex work to support her addiction, according to court documents. On Nov. 13, 1996, she had a minor traffic accident and then sought refuge in Towery's apartment. A heated argument turned violent, leaving Towery dead with part of a lamp lodged within his throat. Holberg left the apartment cut, bruised and bleeding from her head where Towery struck her. While in jail, the Randall County District Attorney's Office approached multiple inmates to question them about Holberg, offering them a deal in exchange for testimony. Kirkpatrick, who was placed in the same cell as Holberg, produced a statement detailing an alleged admission from Holberg. That same day, Kirkpatrick was released on bond. In a lone dissent, circuit judge Stuart Kyle Duncan , a Donald Trump appointee, wrote that the jury did not solely rely on Kirkpatrick's testimony to reach their decision of guilt. "The jury was presented with graphic physical evidence that Holberg sadistically butchered a sick old man--with a lamp rammed down his throat as the coup de grace," Duncan wrote. "That evidence doomed Holberg's self-defense theory and there is no chance that impeaching Kirkpatrick would have resurrected it."" #TXLEGE "Democrats dubious as Texas House begins work on bill using public money for private school ," Dallas Morning News' Phil Jankowski -- "A public hearing on the Texas Legislature's most politically charged issue began Tuesday with tough questions from Democratic lawmakers skeptical of a bill that would allow taxpayer dollars to be spent on private school education. At a House committee hearing on House Bill 3, several hundred people were at the Capitol, awaiting their chance to tell lawmakers in Austin what they think about the bill. Protesters rallied outside the Capitol and Gov. Greg Abbott made his case for school choice at a conservative think tank several blocks away. Abbott has made passing an education savings account bill his top legislative priority. Democrats are largely opposed. Before the hearing began, state officials released a cost estimate of the bill, which would provide about $10,500 in an education savings account to qualifying parents who send their children to private schools. showed a sharply increasing cost of the program, which would grow from an initial price tag of $1 billion in 2026 to nearly $4 billion in 2030. Democratic lawmakers peppered the bill's author, Rep. Brad Buckley , R-Salado, with questions about the bill. Buckley has on several occasions referred to the bill as "empowering parents" to seek the best education for their children. Democrats focused on the program's universal access, which allows parents of all households to apply for state assistance to pay for private school education. The bill creates prioritized access based on income levels if more parents apply than funds are available. Rep. James Talarico , D-Austin, called for limiting the availability of education savings accounts to low- and middle-income families. "I resent the effort to use parents as a shield for this privatization effort," Talarico said. Four Democrats on the House committee considering the bill, including Talarico and Dallas Democratic Rep. John Bryant , called on billionaire megadonor Jeff Yass to testify at Tuesday's hearing. Yass gave as the governor worked to oust House Republicans who opposed a similar bill in 2023. Abbott now believes he to pass his after his endorsed candidates defeated many of those incumbents in the 2024 GOP primary. Supporters say education savings accounts give parents greater control over their child's education and would enable many to move their children to higher performing private schools they might not be able to afford. Opponents say education savings accounts are the first step in the privatization of public education and are an end run to cut state funding to public schools by reducing enrollment. As Abbott made his late-morning appearance before the Texas Public Policy Foundation, the Texas Freedom Network, a group that supports public education, held a Capitol rally to protest the voucher-style bill. "We will not accept the defunding of our neighborhood schools without a fight," said Zeph Capo , president of Texas American Federation of Teachers during the rally of about 30 public education advocates. Capo said Abbott and wealthy megadonors were trying to funnel tax dollars to private schools, which would hurt public education. "Make no mistake, this is an attack on public schools," he said. "It is the playbook we all know too well: Starve schools of resources, shame them for failing to meet unrealistic expectations, and shutter and privatize them." The its version of an education savings account bill. It would give about $10,000 to per student to help pay for private school education. The accounts would be open to all students, but should costs exceed $1 billion, the bill would prioritize special education students, students with disabilities and students with a household income of up to five times the federal poverty level, about $160,750 for a family of four. The size of an education savings account in HB 3 is set at 85% of state and local money spent on the average student, which based on 2024 figures from the Texas Education Agency comes to about $10,983. Both proposals allow for an education savings account to be used on private school tuition, uniforms, textbooks and tutoring." ($) LOCAL GOVERNMENT "Williamson County Judge Bill Gravell resigns to take position in Trump administration ," Austin American-Statesman's Claire Osborn -- "Williamson County Judge Bill Gravell resigned Tuesday to take a position with the Trump administration as the Region 6 advocate for the U.S. Small Business Administration's office of advocacy. Gravell said he applied for the Region 6 position, which covers Texas, New Mexico, Arkansas, Louisiana and Oklahoma, because he felt like he had done a good job in helping small businesses thrive in the county. "For me this is just a continuation of what I was doing in Williamson County but on a larger scale," Gravell said. "I learned during COVID that the backbone to Williamson County was our small businesses." In the past six years, he said, the county has handled 12,500 small business applications. It also saw the expansion of major corporations such as Apple, Samsung and Kalahari Resorts. Gravell, 61, announced his resignation at the Commissioners Court meeting. District Judge Betsy Lambeth swore Gravell into his new office as advocate a few minutes after Gravell resigned. "It is a great honor to serve as the voice for the 4.5 million small businesses that make the South-Central region of the United States their home," Gravell said. "Growing up at 1402 East Main Street in Round Rock, Texas, I never could have imagined that one day I would have the opportunity to serve the United States. This is truly an honor, but I will never forget where I came from." The commissioners will appoint a new county judge to serve until the next general election on Nov. 3, 2026. They will hold a special session at 11 a.m. Friday to accept Gravell's resignation and to discuss the appointment of the new county judge. Gravell said the county has prospered in the six years he has been judge with the appraised value growing from $84 billion to $180 billion. Gravell, a former youth pastor and justice of the peace, was sworn in as county judge Jan. 1, 2019. He won re-election in 2022. As county judge, Gravell served as the director of emergency management during local disasters, navigating several crises through his tenure, according to a county news release. Those crises included the COVID-19 pandemic, tornadoes, fires and the deadly February 2021 freeze, Gravell said. His greatest accomplishment as judge, he said, was leading "during some of the most complex and difficult times our county has ever faced." "I have strived daily to protect our citizens and the future of our citizens," Gravell said. ... Gravell said his new job, which has just started, involves being an advocate for small businesses to make sure new rules and regulations they might face don't damage them, he said. Gravell said he would remain based in Georgetown with some traveling to other states. Gravell was in his second term as county judge when he resigned. He served from 2013-2018 as a justice of the peace and also served for 22 years as a youth pastor. "I'd like to say to the young people and to my grandchildren," Gravell said on Tuesday, "no matter where your start in life, with hard work, with dedication and with following the Lord you can go anywhere. ... America is still the land of opportunity and I've proven that."" ($) 2026 "Mayra Guill en, sister of Vanessa Guillen, eyeing a challenge to Houston Rep. Guillen, who has never held public office, has become an outspoken advocate for of sexual harassment and assault cases since her sister's death. Guillen announced her run after Green's interrupted President Donald Trump 's address last week. Green was later censured by the majority Republican chamber. ($) BUSINESS NEWS "Southwest Airlines plans to end its free checked bag policy for some travelers ," Houston Chronicle's Octavia Johnson -- " its bag policy and will being requiring travelers who don't qualify for free bag options to pay for their first two bags at check-in. This comes months after the Texas-based airline as one of the company's efforts to keep and attract customers amid its financial struggles. Southwest will begin charging customers for the first and second checked bags May 28, according to a news release. Travelers on the A-list loyalty program (preferred status member) or using business fare will not have to pay the checked bag fees. "We have tremendous opportunity to meet current and future Customer needs, attract new Customer segments we don't compete for today, and return to the levels of profitability that both we and our Shareholders expect," said Bob Jordan , president and chief executive officer of Southwest, in a statement. The fee amount for checked bags was unclear as of Tuesday morning. The airline also announced adjustments to the Rapid Rewards points earned by travelers on qualifying flights, the release reads. Travelers can earn more points on business fares. The loyalty program will also introduce variable redemption rates across higher- and lower-demand flights, according to the release. Flights and fare products will be available to book on the third-party online travel agency Expedia. "We will do all this while remaining focused on what's made us strong -- our people and the authentic, friendly, and award-winning Customer Service only they can provide," Jordan said in a statement. Last year, Jordan initially told investors there were no plans to charge for the first two bags, . He said the free bag check-in was why customers chose Southwest. Other initiatives consist of implementing assigned seating, extra legroom options and the airline's first-ever scheduled overnight redeye flights. The changes at Southwest have been introduced after activist investor Elliot Investment Management called for changes to leadership and operations in hopes of improving the airline financially. [ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

Bernie created Our Revolution nearly a decade ago as part of his life’s
mission to build enduring progressive power from the bottom up. Since
then, our grassroots army and voter mobilization machine have helped elect
more than 1,000 progressives up and down the ballot. And we’re just
getting started.

50 days into Trump’s presidency, our work is more important than ever.
We’re witnessing the dismantling of our democracy — and in its place,
Trump is methodically installing an oligarchy – a government run by
billionaires for the billionaires. A system rigged in favor of the
wealthiest and most powerful men on earth at the expense of everyone else.

Our Revolution is fighting back, growing our Citizen Action Team,
organizing to help progressive candidates win, and creating a collective,
organized front to break up corporate power and fight tirelessly for
working families. And that essential work will continue long past Trump.

To help ensure Our Revolution is able to carry on Bernie’s work in the
years and decades to come, Our Revolution is launching a new partnership
with [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/22377?t=1011&akid=7834%2E5885482%2EtO6L0G ]FreeWill. 2⁄3 of Americans don’t have an up-to-date will, and
FreeWill makes it simple and easy to create one. It takes just 20 minutes
to write your will using their [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/22377?t=1012&akid=7834%2E5885482%2EtO6L0G ]secure online tool — and the best part
is it’s free.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/22377?t=1013&akid=7834%2E5885482%2EtO6L0G ]CREATE MY FREE WILL

Bernie has been clear from the beginning that transformative change will
require both an inside and outside strategy that takes on corporate power
everywhere — including within the Democratic Party. As he fights
tirelessly to do that in Congress, Our Revolution works on the outside,
taking to the streets, the phones, and the ballot boxes.

Together, we are methodically building the progressive power we need to
transform our country. By engaging in local races that too often get
ignored, we are creating the infrastructure of power at the level of
government closest to people’s lives. By mobilizing the grassroots to
demand better of our elected officials, we are winning fights and showing
the strength of our movement.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/22377?t=1014&akid=7834%2E5885482%2EtO6L0G ]We’re sharing FreeWill with you today because it’s an essential step
for protecting your loved ones, planning for your assets, and building
generational wealth for the communities and causes you care about. And by
incorporating a gift to Our Revolution in your will, you will help build a
legacy that will help build enduring progressive power in the years to
come.

If you have any questions, do not hesitate to reach out
to [ mailto:freewill@ourrevolution.com ]freewill@ourrevolution.com.

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

Right now, we have a once-in-a-generation chance to make real, lasting change to the country we know and love.
I’d like to explain why if you’ll indulge me for a moment.
I'd like to explain why if you'll indulge me for a moment.
| |
---
| | | Hi, it's Vivek Ramaswamy.

I wanted you to hear this directly from me: _I JUST announced my candidacy for Governor of Ohio. _
---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=067ccc34b83f442ea999e0c923400e37&_e=aMl9NsPz976YPUrnHBwqhkQXvSDiVXqH8pjg6LW5-Z5cjJ9073hoR7am4fkcZR4eejlLkpIQXRTO-jz6OOzgVFpTEN8UK71VgoARpah34QOb3gCPkOA0pJEKYriBv3VG-LkDcj6PMRxehbKBHvdHCdGJb2AEYnoE8cxLQG0yxnXBJML1M38RT5wUbMKh_hinSTSXNXYoFEMkQyU_OSIIFpx7caLYx0C7HjtfRYLkmcrmWA3_SjTUht5xaEV9g-6aDbqqqHB6R8d6wLMPlxrciiK1V5hG-5dS2Q4B_UqsZi9UpoC9Til6WGHvCJe7_zN_lnCiBSAuIM1QPpEFlFLVQwN6RKgyE0_Ik2RIh9kRXVkTgUYSNspDWuUb608B99S7lAS-7f2swXdP3VhNYHdS6fpfTkxbeKipPVLIVTFfEPI%3D)
---
**[In a moment, I'm going to ask you to become a Founding Donor to this historic campaign - but first, I'd like to explain why if you'll indulge me for a moment.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=067ccc34b83f442ea999e0c923400e37&_e=aMl9NsPz976YPUrnHBwqhkQXvSDiVXqH8pjg6LW5-Z5cjJ9073hoR7am4fkcZR4eejlLkpIQXRTO-jz6OOzgVFpTEN8UK71VgoARpah34QOb3gCPkOA0pJEKYriBv3VG-LkDcj6PMRxehbKBHvdHCdGJb2AEYnoE8cxLQG0yxnXBJML1M38RT5wUbMKh_hinSTSXNXYoFEMkQyU_OSIIFpx7caLYx0C7HjtfRYLkmcrmWA3_SjTUht5xaEV9g-6aDbqqqHB6R8d6wLMPlxrcijarfVyv_YGDCzHk9ytQVv03xQXwQfjowgb1e_lHZIne1B9NvtcncF2tjFqu68k-NhOJe3GasQYmjHGTROCdR9f8LB6V4YTyC_umUBknIwHuEul123jy2e5NpgvaXdaXLXB0H2D26WWyAK_GcDmZR8c%3D "In a moment, I’m going to ask you to become a Founding Donor to this historic campaign – but first, I’d like to explain why if you’ll indulge me for a moment.")**

---
** WHY RUN NOW? **
---
President Trump winning re-election in November was not just another political victory - it was a seismic realignment for our country. He won every swing state. He improved his vote share of minorities and young voters. We won the House AND Senate. And heck, he even won the popular vote.

---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=067ccc34b83f442ea999e0c923400e37&_e=aMl9NsPz976YPUrnHBwqhkQXvSDiVXqH8pjg6LW5-Z5cjJ9073hoR7am4fkcZR4eejlLkpIQXRTO-jz6OOzgVFpTEN8UK71VgoARpah34QOb3gCPkOA0pJEKYriBv3VG-LkDcj6PMRxehbKBHvdHCdGJb2AEYnoE8cxLQG0yxnXBJML1M38RT5wUbMKh_hinSTSXNXYoFEMkQyU_OSIIFpx7caLYx0C7HjtfRYLkmcrmWA3_SjTUht5xaEV9g-6aDbqqqHB6R8d6wLMPlxrcigD3LoysKyU6wV9hY1UXRaGbUJn6z-EXSjS1xD3HsPm1E2-Y1pWsI8S9oqePVfXi2kewoz6RxExw5urhooc619qyMcV0BvuegY-K8QhzD-A0HLzVabsh97FV_FgihNwAV-xd2lZMmQ5Zui5dysKuiEw%3D)
---
It was the honor of a lifetime to rally voters in battleground states, campaign on college campuses to turn out Gen-Z for Trump, and promote his America First vision at rally after rally.

---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=067ccc34b83f442ea999e0c923400e37&_e=aMl9NsPz976YPUrnHBwqhkQXvSDiVXqH8pjg6LW5-Z5cjJ9073hoR7am4fkcZR4eejlLkpIQXRTO-jz6OOzgVFpTEN8UK71VgoARpah34QOb3gCPkOA0pJEKYriBv3VG-LkDcj6PMRxehbKBHvdHCdGJb2AEYnoE8cxLQG0yxnXBJML1M38RT5wUbMKh_hinSTSXNXYoFEMkQyU_OSIIFpx7caLYx0C7HjtfRYLkmcrmWA3_SjTUht5xaEV9g-6aDbqqqHB6R8d6wLMPlxrcirh99tw80Dec0Ksrugko6EDshZ8DgV4VOwx6qFszwbtEEw9lB8GWF6IioL16nM-cvFMkVVg5NQMA963j5kyJT0y_Ln463o-3TsOrZWCnz-HbFVyfvoh1uIoRHsZxdw5Lbr5MYH76iZViSJ2E6u45c30%3D)
---
Right now, we have a once-in-a-generation chance to make real, lasting change to the country we know and love. It's an opportunity to not just ticker around the edges of the Federal Government, but to upend it completely.

This is our moment to GUT the managerial bureaucracy, FIRE anyone connected to the weaponization of our own government against us, SLASH the size and scope of the administrative state, and usher in the GOLDEN AGE for America!

But the Deep State is already putting up the fight of its life. They're resisting change at every turn. Make no mistake - we can't afford to squander this historic opportunity. That's why President Trump needs trusted partnerships at the state level RIGHT NOW!

---
** WHY OHIO? **
---
This one's easy. I was born and raised here in the Buckeye State and graduated from St. Xavier - a Catholic high school in Cincinnati. My wife, Apporva, and I live outside Columbus, raising our two boys here. I've started multiple businesses in Ohio. Hey all,
The DOGE, led by Elon Musk under President Trump's directive, has embarked on the mission to eliminate waste, fraud, and abuse within the federal government, however the rapid pace and targets of these initiatives has raised concerns, even among the GOP itself.
I need your help to put an end to the overstep in government measures.
Representative John Rutherford of Jacksonville has expressed the need for greater transparency regarding the proposed cuts. He noted that DOGE's swift actions have left many with "their heads spinning," emphasizing the importance of understanding the specific implications before they are implemented. Rutherford stated, "I want more information about what's going to happen before it happens."
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/54553357536B4F4E746946304462466D376D6741706779613165376B775335304A2B52495452414B7A42305873473536483162345A796A70677A507636617438/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-03-11%20at%2011.53.13%E2%80%AFAM.png]
One significant concern is the potential sale of the Charles E. Bennett Federal Building in Jacksonville, identified among 440 structures that could be sold. This building houses essential services, including the Internal Revenue Service, Department of Labor, and Housing and Urban Development functions. Additionally, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Jacksonville District is vacating its Southbank offices, further impacting our local infrastructure. The last thing I want for my district is a reduction in infrastructure.
While the pursuit of efficiency is vital, it is equally important to ensure that such measures do not compromise essential services or adversely affect our community.

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that Planned Parenthood received **$699 million dollars** from taxpayers in the last reported year? In fact, the abortion corporation has received billions of dollars from the government over the past few decades!

Based on reporting from its 2022-2023 annual report, Planned Parenthood killed approximately 1,076 preborn babies every day, 45 every hour, and one every 80 seconds. Its annual killing rate has increased by 20,000 since the previous reported year.

Thankfully, national leaders are beginning to take notice.

President Trump has chosen Elon Musk to head the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), a new government agency that aims to reduce waste and spending, including potentially pulling federal funding from Planned Parenthood.

Last fall, Elon Musk co-authored an op-ed, published by the Wall Street Journal (WSJ), which said:

_" ...DOGE will help end federal overspending by taking aim at the $500 billion plus in annual federal expenditures that are unauthorized by Congress or being used in ways that Congress never intended, from $535 million a year to the Corporation for Public Broadcasting and $1.5 billion for grants to international organizations to nearly $300 million to progressive groups like Planned Parenthood."_

This is incredibly hopeful news, Friend of Life, but it's not final. [ ](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/47ONoBXTGUyXEoZxZN2NDZSKUdktRgQq7ohJ9g23rhwrFciQ0h7p8EUJVmjoSgivDaKbR4QH-soKefmk4h7K1YRifB_cTCVcuRMfc5-AelbHwSGAfzMyAhRaiidUxCrB7uP6SeoLuKMH8aHq3UGXCd_XPhuUHpBmVW96Zakzb6lS5pTyDuicZDr1EOev1uTSGzmBqJf4nN2LZd3FhZU6TFQXQeczFv6VTgWSzIgd4XFJWm0s58tD2nqS-mQWI47EzamH0eoQ77sb2dMpC5Vh6B93vaB96PqXYwrHY9Vklf8FTUQN2xCgUANfp-8P919xK3Y88B010Mk9RsSUyZlidNxTBzTvSoYj0S1u_gUU5UmBl45dYvNXrpE1yuZI0h1qMnrfmexVlgXURqyevygo_OOsZQ1jmnvuYvG5sAk35AhvmmyUhNmlKcgsgnc/CQYeffKHXSjY3cxieEgelLqVUGRdSSzT/6)
The fact that more people are recognizing our tax dollars should not go to such an evil corporation is surely due to the persistent activism of pro-life work to expose the horrific truth about Planned Parenthood.

To keep pressure on the Trump administration, Live Action is spearheading a petition that will go to these national leaders, demanding the idea of defunding Planned Parenthood become a reality. **Sign your name here, and share it with your friends and family:[https://www.liveaction.org/end-taxpayer-dollars-to-planned-parenthood](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/QevJgjzKhCWf5UoESLaG5Gk9yPg81S58M4Qrej5P0yzAlT8MZUD5dCLXW3I2mQS3ceqTOhoMOgmcaRlDtPnH_SZtOQZ26k99I5s7po2HKkHVaDr5-yJMMAmQ3I1jCiQPbAeeVRWDaOGVFXdlLM-Km0-7xw60FJga5G8IfYLtL8cRoumQFlV70-Unt8sBEDvChADnBE7OW-F3KxHmqx-G59MjKBE9xBFtuCrzpsBAGQN92LgWcHw_nWJQnsmsAhxqe67ueLILgoVrFyJBKkGJ4nyb4RnkssxDj4n3jfX5kxOwRDVPjhAveCuQc7iMN8zDdW3rrB_J7EwGJMw7TST7ZnG84TYjGLHVg_MXmLUS22i5rHZIV2oOXZOHSQW5jKCB7nEyyvM8cqP1fNldAkE9cz05HQ1aN5Wb4D1OwLE6e8Lz0mQaC2f1AZ1MoZs/PK2y3_NKM3eLiGQSKvtlaihHl7S_ogTu/6)**

Defunding Planned Parenthood will require more than DOGE's involvement. We need the HHS leadership (recently confirmed Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.) to get on board, as well as obvious leadership from President Trump.

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dfp3eikuppluj8w7246ues6yidxvjz69e7jybfp8nlpdzl41cowsvt1wavikw4sby6pbnklezubotdwhtsky3524215ddoh08lra29bx7s7wuaotmkrlku0fw07j1n32idkz2tyozzr4apsaz71b&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sszd70&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sszd70&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Peter, Women's History Month is a time to celebrate and honor the incredible women whose courage, strength, and leadership shape our world every day. I grew up witnessing the power of trailblazing women. My mom was one of the first female TV news anchors in the 1970s. Although women weren’t welcomed in the newsroom then, my mom helped break the glass ceiling and paved the way for countless others. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103690155/532924553/-77384076?refcode=AU_GWN_CL_GEN_NOA_AC_20250311_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDE5NGM3OS1jOWZlLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Ujf_4WgivMgC4JYN6uHUQAWZlJYF7MedB_9Ld3C87Q=) As a husband and a father to a wonderful daughter, Adeline, I’m aware of the profound impact that strong, empowered women can have on our families, communities, and society as a whole. That’s why I am committed to ensuring she grows up in a world where women's voices are respected, valued, and empowered. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103690156/532924554/-77384076?refcode=AU_GWN_CL_GEN_NOA_AC_20250311_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDE5NGM3OS1jOWZlLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Ujf_4WgivMgC4JYN6uHUQAWZlJYF7MedB_9Ld3C87Q=) For that to happen, we have to ensure that women have the freedom to make their own decisions about their futures. Protecting the rights of women to make their own choices isn't just personal — it's essential for a fairer, stronger society. I encourage each of you to take time this month to reflect on the achievements of the incredible women in your lives, express gratitude, and consider how we can continue working together to build a more just and equal society for all. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103690157/532924555/-77384076?refcode=AU_GWN_CL_GEN_NOA_AC_20250311_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDE5NGM3OS1jOWZlLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Ujf_4WgivMgC4JYN6uHUQAWZlJYF7MedB_9Ld3C87Q=) This month, I hope you'll join me in recognizing the inspiring women in your life. Let's honor their achievements and recommit ourselves to building a future defined by equality, opportunity, and justice. Derek, If you’re looking for a way to make an impact _right now_ , we’re here to tell you this is it. Let us explain: There are critical races happening right now in Wisconsin that are flying under the radar — but the outcome will directly impact people’s lives for the next decade. **On April 1, in one of those races, voters will elect a justice to the state Supreme Court for a 10-year term. The winner will be the swing vote in all Court decisions.** That’s why Republicans are laser-focused on this race, and we need to be, too. If he becomes the deciding vote on the state Supreme Court, the consequences could be disastrous for people all over the state. Wisconsinites deserve better than an election bought and paid for by an out-of-touch billionaire. That’s why it’s so important we win this race — and it’s why we’re committed to investing as much as we can to ensure Democrats have the resources they’ll need in Wisconsin for this election and those to come. body:
Elon Musk called me a traitor. He tweeted that in response to my visit to Ukraine and Poland.
#

Elon Musk called me a traitor, Peter.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-mek-em-mar25.qIyu4X&refcode=em250311-1-f&t=1&akid=3757%2E734936%2EUGsTiX)
He tweeted that in response to my visit to Ukraine and Poland. “You are a traitor,” for having dinner with American soldiers deployed to Poland. “You are a traitor” for meeting with Ukrainians defending their country from a Russian invasion. “You are a traitor” for visiting with nurses and doctors in hospitals that treat Ukrainian soldiers wounded in combat.
When I joined the Navy, I swore an oath to support and defend the Constitution. I did it again when I was sworn in as Arizona’s United States Senator. I will continue to uphold that oath, and because it matters to our national security, I’m going to stand with Ukraine until they win a peace that protects their sovereignty and safety.
Elon is only looking out for himself. And if he doesn’t understand that defending freedom is a basic tenet of what makes America great and keeps us safe, maybe he should leave it to those of us who do.
I’ll be honest with you, though. If the richest man on Earth is lining up against me, it’s going to take a big team to fight back.

Here's what's going on:

**First,** Elon Musk bankrolled**** Donald Trump's reelection campaign – spending a staggering _$288 million_ to put him back in the White House.

**Then,** Trump gave Musk free rein over our federal government – including access to your personal information, like your bank accounts and Social Security number.

**Now,** Musk is on a rampage to completely dismantle our government – firing federal workers and slashing critical programs that millions rely on, including veterans services, food assistance, aviation safety, and more.
So, you might be wondering why Musk even cares about federal programs in the first place? It's simple: **Musk is advocating for a plan to take money from the federal programs that help _you_ – all to pay for more tax cuts for billionaires like _him._**
But let me tell you: I'm not going to let it happen. Not on my watch. Not to give money to billionaires like Elon Musk, who don't need another cent.

Trump has shown us that when the American people are angry enough – and _loud enough_ – he reverses course. I know you're angry. So now, it's time to get loud. I took the Senate floor to speak out against Elon Musk's corrupt power grab, and I plan to continue doing everything in my power to stop his reckless agenda. But I need your voice in this fight, friend.
**I'm looking for 10,000 members of this team to speak out alongside me by signing my petition before midnight tonight. At this urgent moment, with everything from Medicaid to Social Security to veterans benefits on the line, can I count on you to add your name?**

At EMILYs List, we're committed to taking back power so we can stop the GOP's assault on our rights. Our mission is to elect leaders who will safeguard our democracy and ensure that everybody has the freedom to make decisions about their own body.

But we can't do it alone. Our strength lies in our members — individuals like you who believe in the importance of choice and are willing to stand up against those determined to take away our fundamental freedoms. [****[**By becoming a member today, you ensure we have the strength and resources to stop anti-abortion extremists and elect more Democratic pro-choice women. Will you join the movement?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103691119/532928281/2025016054?refcode=WUEFE323_20250311_BadGroups_ALL_v2s1&sourceid=1055795&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlODVlY2Q4Yy1jY2ZlLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C-09HEkMOnVXcjbtoChCq-wqDPI9jDSp7hiDhsmIDrY=) | [BECOME A MEMBER](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103691121/532928287/2025016054?refcode=WUEFE323_20250311_BadGroups_ALL_v2s1&sourceid=1055795&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlODVlY2Q4Yy1jY2ZlLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C-09HEkMOnVXcjbtoChCq-wqDPI9jDSp7hiDhsmIDrY=)

We've always known that anti-choice extremists wouldn't stop at banning abortion. Now, they want to _punish women_ for their health care decisions. Anti-abortion groups are pushing for policies that would allow employers to penalize women who take time off to seek an abortion — for any reason at all — or to deal with related medical care.

Ongoing lawsuits by these groups show their true intention: to strip away not only reproductive freedom, but also basic workplace protections for women. Conservative so-called "family values" advocates are now fighting to ensure women face consequences for making the decision they believe is best for themselves and their families. And we can't let them get away with that.

Our mission is to elect leaders who will safeguard our democracy and ensure that everybody has the freedom to make decisions about their own body. But we can't do it alone. Our strength lies in our members — individuals like you who believe in the importance of choice and are willing to stand up against those determined to take away our fundamental freedoms. = | = We've always known that anti-choice extremists wouldn't stop at banning abortion. Now, they want to punish women for their health care decisions. Anti-abortion groups are pushing for policies that would allow employers to penalize women who take time off to seek an abortion — for any reason at all — or to deal with related medical care. Ongoing lawsuits by these groups show their true intention: to strip away not only reproductive freedom, but also basic workplace protections for women. Peter, yesterday marked Day 50 of the Trump administration. We know it’s gut-wrenching to watch what they are doing to our country and to people across the globe — slashing critical government services and foreign aid, firing thousands of federal workers, and ignoring the rule of law. But you know what would be even worse? **Not being able to fight back.** We don’t have to sit on the sidelines and simply watch in horror. **We are tackling the anti-democratic MAGA agenda head-on:**
* **Helping elect Democracy Defenders to state-level offices that are critical to ensuring free and fair elections**
* **Pushing back against GOP attempts to silence voters through gerrymandering**
* **Fighting for fair maps — including ahead of next year’s U.S. House elections — so elected officials represent the will of the people**

The “flood the zone” approach — issuing an endless stream of harmful and outrageous policies — is meant to disorient and distract us. * Lower childcare costs, by making sure Universal Pre-K is truly universal, and ensure all children have access to free school meals.
* Lower housing costs, by cutting property taxes, slashing red tape for new projects, and building more housing that is affordable.
* Lower utility bills, by expanding clean energy production with an “All-of-the-Above” approach and modernizing our grid.
* Lower the cost of food, by cracking down on meat producer monopolies and expanding regional supply chains.
* Lower healthcare costs, by making high-quality care more accessible and meeting the needs of seniors.

Lower housing costs, by cutting property taxes, slashing red tape for new projects, and building more housing that is affordable. Lower utility bills, by expanding clean energy production with an “All-of-the-Above” approach and modernizing our grid. name: Kimberly Bretches
subject: The George Floyd riots continue to haunt my husband
body:
| | | The same city that gave Chance this award is trying to put him in prison for life for doing his job.
---
| |
---
Dear Patriot, That's me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches in the picture I've sent you...
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=4ca9dc258d2242ffb4db0180a2206af1&_e=XF1y1i7xIJ2HLzobxk5wxwDsPlHrryShJkRwjgPT_PpugKj-n31dNxDfpGlTgCddvZ5EBoZXb4E3PXNIUgUQYwGCVob5cR4Pgyw56ubfHUeXuyCDpKXHVAjSR5bt26lznZkESTK12vPJmky9ruBrGm1JY5c9QhOqcdyX7ZAjEZW3MOuXWeRlIgm_1t-pnq7Y-P2PUhhG4xwc-1ZJY_QinPTXrbvSUMOIvjJpVjv9iIuoKgzlxJzS7lykmQhjbWSvy0HHn4TASKOU91aWsBHki8M-p686W1v0_LOK-UanlGcnuM0tQb6ieRlo-lsG17ov31kD4m1wpiuHMC0No5ajwl_v1uNqhf4mFEpaU9y7SiJCbvJA7E113YR7pYiVyaUp)
---
...a picture we took on the day Chance received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor for rescuing a driver from a crashed car that had caught on fire. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because in July, the same city that gave Chance this award... ...will try to lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? _**[Would you help by sending a one-time gift to LELDF so this amazing group can defend my husband and the other good police officers who have wrongly accused?](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=4ca9dc258d2242ffb4db0180a2206af1&_e=XF1y1i7xIJ2HLzobxk5wxwDsPlHrryShJkRwjgPT_PpugKj-n31dNxDfpGlTgCddvZ5EBoZXb4E3PXNIUgUQYwGCVob5cR4Pgyw56ubfHUeXuyCDpKXHVAjSR5bt26lznZkESTK12vPJmky9ruBrGm1JY5c9QhOqcdyX7ZAjEZW3MOuXWeRlIgm_1t-pnq7Y-P2PUhhG4xwc-1ZJY_QinPTXrbvSUMOIvjJpVjv9iIujxr5nljoUir8RaqeC2Kf0j6-rUspxAt9xmW40cFO7M_VWuFBlglDC753LUNsJEJVX9WsNNAm51B9nFn__l92e3S13G0VBBVLlM2WST3tyoT-zm3PpF9xHw40Rt1e1PXMYPLhlXKOnF2tIJHA9Y7wO)**_** ** You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. _**[So with that in mind, please know that any contribution -- be it $35, $100, $500 or even $1,000 -- is tax-deductible.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=4ca9dc258d2242ffb4db0180a2206af1&_e=XF1y1i7xIJ2HLzobxk5wxwDsPlHrryShJkRwjgPT_PpugKj-n31dNxDfpGlTgCddvZ5EBoZXb4E3PXNIUgUQYwGCVob5cR4Pgyw56ubfHUeXuyCDpKXHVAjSR5bt26lznZkESTK12vPJmky9ruBrGm1JY5c9QhOqcdyX7ZAjEZW3MOuXWeRlIgm_1t-pnq7Y-P2PUhhG4xwc-1ZJY_QinPTXrbvSUMOIvjJpVjv9iIseQsSdIiLR36KIOayWFdV1yBqDtI15C7IPhHg-jpoL3wV7BJtcHOTRFKJdIYj7qzNr0QU0S_1DDZjTbJyjD2dIjfzKqZHsB-hxggpjXmyWI-L8-yfIlCAT7d1MzHhF-S13klpwrflNicXi_YcVBeBQ)**_ But whatever you feel led to give, please end it back quickly. Chance's trial starts on July 7th. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he'll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle somebody... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. _**[So please, my friend, rush back your gift right away if possible.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=4ca9dc258d2242ffb4db0180a2206af1&_e=XF1y1i7xIJ2HLzobxk5wxwDsPlHrryShJkRwjgPT_PpugKj-n31dNxDfpGlTgCddvZ5EBoZXb4E3PXNIUgUQYwGCVob5cR4Pgyw56ubfHUeXuyCDpKXHVAjSR5bt26lznZkESTK12vPJmky9ruBrGm1JY5c9QhOqcdyX7ZAjEZW3MOuXWeRlIgm_1t-pnq7Y-P2PUhhG4xwc-1ZJY_QinPTXrbvSUMOIvjJpVjv9iIsm2Exk6lppJocT_Jaj3U4rwTmFOCnha8S0SDiYcgf8es92G6dMQf2U6yjmDtc6NSnRagzvsQ4PJrgIXjTviLvEjZFI3z2OdJLuWSnl_dCyZ8Asp969OByF_cVdX2Kv3qoQdFadThIj0retQ_miLLTs)**_ With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, _**[your gift of $35](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=4ca9dc258d2242ffb4db0180a2206af1&_e=XF1y1i7xIJ2HLzobxk5wxwDsPlHrryShJkRwjgPT_PpugKj-n31dNxDfpGlTgCddvZ5EBoZXb4E3PXNIUgUQYwGCVob5cR4Pgyw56ubfHUeXuyCDpKXHVAjSR5bt26lznZkESTK12vPJmky9ruBrGm1JY5c9QhOqcdyX7ZAjEZW3MOuXWeRlIgm_1t-pnq7Y-P2PUhhG4xwc-1ZJY_QinPTXrbvSUMOIvjJpVjv9iItzP5EbqaP9OWaIHchXn8Fpv9Bt2DwuMNYPM79fFre0NtLEDuJHoYX2GTj0k_lEtsrkqneTegQ7520O3uE1d1ZF691q9a7bMtNnTPQSY_JZn6Bsfh6Xme3aWFSSSeUL9Zxr2IwhCExQl4C-wazlWGIV)**_ \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back.
---
With hope and thanks,
---
Kimberly Bretches
---
P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protestors. Now life behind bars could be his "reward."And to make things worse, we're up against the deep pockets of a George Soros backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance's trial begins. Chance and I have three children -- and one more on the way. Please don't let them grow up without their father. _**[Thank you for any help you can send to LELDF today.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=4ca9dc258d2242ffb4db0180a2206af1&_e=XF1y1i7xIJ2HLzobxk5wxwDsPlHrryShJkRwjgPT_PpugKj-n31dNxDfpGlTgCddvZ5EBoZXb4E3PXNIUgUQYwGCVob5cR4Pgyw56ubfHUeXuyCDpKXHVAjSR5bt26lznZkESTK12vPJmky9ruBrGm1JY5c9QhOqcdyX7ZAjEZW3MOuXWeRlIgm_1t-pnq7Y-P2PUhhG4xwc-1ZJY_QinPTXrbvSUMOIvjJpVjv9iIsMzA-3qmdPWI7ima0eToTenDdDfDHYe4pCXPNVRPHhpuGKo9g4MqBzjY2dzQZfy_Juk37EPEMtnVjglkqfuCblI71_ytRoZr_Ycm8IEjYqRWt16RLruL5c-P0Vbvq41nq4CuHY3PqY-DvbIr90Nxii)**_

We have very little time to act before Chance's trial begins. Chance and I have three children -- and one more on the way. Please don't let them grow up without their father. | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. body:
Information to share with your immigrant community about the future of DACA | | | Peter, **🚨 The latest Fifth Circuit Court decision on DACA is expected to take effect today.** Back in January, the Fifth Circuit issued a ruling that would potentially open first-time applications and potentially end work permit access for DACA recipients living in Texas, keeping only the deportation protections part of the DACA program. Today, this decision is expected to go into effect. **What does this mean for your loved ones?**
* **👉 For current DACA recipients:** Renewals remain open, and they’ll continue to have protections from deportation, even if they live in Texas. 🗣️ They should talk to a trusted lawyer, and renew their DACA as soon as possible.

* **👉 For DACA recipients living in Texas:** They’ll continue to have access to renewals for protection from deportation.**💼 Their work authorization will remain in effect for the time being,** but depending on what the Trump admin does next, the decision on whether future first-time applications and renewals include work permits if you reside in Texas will go back down to Judge Hanen to determine when/how this takes effect.

* **👉 For first-time applicants:** Trump’s administration has not yet issued official guidance, and no new applications have been processed. If you know of anyone considering applying for the first time, remember that they’ll be providing their personal information to an administration we know will target immigrants at all costs. 🗣️They should speak with a trusted attorney to make an informed decision.

For years, we’ve been fighting to secure protections for our siblings, friends, and loved ones who were locked out of the program when Trump first tried to shut it down in 2017. Today should’ve been a day of celebration for our communities. Instead, we’re reminded that DACA continues to be under attack. **We cannot ignore that at any moment, Trump could decide to end DACA on his own and could abuse our personal data to target and abduct people in our communities. With ICE raids and abductions escalating across the country, our fight is far from over!** That’s why we’re using this moment to recharge and continue fighting for the only real solution: A pathway to citizenship for all in our communities. With people’s lives and futures on the line, Congress must do its part to keep families together and deliver a pathway to citizenship for all.
